basic_profile.summary:

Currently serving as Chief Security Officer at Delhivery, I design and oversee security, trust, and safety frameworks across India’s largest logistics network — covering 24 automated sort centers, 90+ fulfilment hubs, 2,500+ delivery centers, and 58,000+ employees.

Previously, as a Superintendent of Police in Pondicherry, I specialized in trafficking, narcotics enforcement, cybercrime, and community policing, achieving a 99% conviction rate and pioneering India’s early cybercrime investigations.

I’ve driven business continuity, fraud prevention, safety, and compliance strategies for Fortune 500s, airports, defense, banking, and e-commerce. My leadership philosophy is built on change management, operational excellence, and digital transformation — blending public service discipline with corporate agility.

Recognized with awards including the Golden Peacock Award, SECONA Shield for Security Project of the Year, and Assocham SME Excellence Award, I also hold patents and publications on e-governance, fraud detection, and women’s safety tech solutions.

past.employee_title: Head - Logistics Compliance and Corporate Affairs
past.employee_description:
Led compliance and corporate affairs team for Amazon logistics. Spearheaded engagement with multiple state governments in India for business continuity situations due to the rapidly changing tax and entry tax laws. Product managed the Amazon technology solution to automate the compliance requirements for movement of shipment across states in India.

1. Heading the regulatory operations at a country level and ensuring 100% compliance towards laws with smooth movement across the borders of states. Appointed a team of ~10 consultants to manage all the line haul movement across all modes.

One of the founding members of the Amazon Logistics, India launch team handling multiple projects/roles across network design, product, operations, channel development, corporate affairs, procurement, new initiatives at national and zonal levels. In the last assignment at Amazon, I was heading the regional operations including channel development for alternate deliveries for north last mile operations. 

1. Led a diverse team, that manages an assorted network of forward and reverse mile operations. Network handled ~2L shipments per day with 70+ hubs and 3.5k manpower. It involved handling the entire P&L. 
2. Built a high-performance team that delivered consistently for three years (2015-2017), on exponentially increasing complexity of e-commerce deliveries. 
3. Scaled the variable delivery channel (like I Have Space, Service Partner etc.) to support 10X growth in delivery operations. Optimising cost by ~40% while maintaining service levels of the network. 
4. Channel Development of I Have Space stores from ~500 to 3500 stores in a span of 8 months leading to their contribution shooting to ~65% from 15%. 
5. Design of two futuristic products to scale delivery operations for year 2020 plan. Operating design for both models has been stress tested and one of the models is part of a worldwide product. Estimated saving of ~ $200 MM in India operations. 
6. Build a lean work force engagement model for capacity optimisation in the last mile for managing the peak volumes). Achieved 35% improvement in the capacity utilisation.

basic_profile.name: Vidya Bhushan
basic_profile.headline: AI/ML Product Leader | IIT KGP | IIM A | SST | Built & Scaled India’s Largest Smart Vending Network
basic_profile.summary:
I’m a product and strategy leader with 14+ years of experience scaling AI-first digital platforms across consumer tech, fintech, and enterprise SaaS.

As the Co-founder of Daalchini Technologies, I led the company from inception to becoming India’s largest AI-powered smart vending network, with 2,500+ IoT-enabled kiosks across 78 cities and 21 states, processing over 100,000 transactions per day. We pioneered out-of-home (OOH) Q-commerce and contactless retail—building a tech platform that merged real-time analytics, AI/ML-driven inventory optimization, and IoT-based automation.

Before Daalchini, I was part of the national launch team at Jio and led fintech innovations at Paytm and Paysafe, building scale-first mobile products that served millions.

I bring a rare blend of deep technical fluency, platform-thinking, and P&L ownership—having built cross-functional teams, raised $9M+ in venture funding, and steered operations to profitability.

🎓 I hold a B.Tech from IIT Kharagpur (DAAD Scholar, YAAA Awardee) and an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. My research in AI-driven decision-making using EEG and neural networks was published in PLOS ONE and informs my passion for applied AI in real-world systems.

I’m now focused on driving product leadership in GenAI, enterprise SaaS, and telecom-AI intersections, and open to advisory and leadership roles that seek to blend AI innovation with business scale.

past.employee_description:
Project: Microcontroller Programming for Control of Mobile Robot

This project aimed at the development of a robot called ARMER, which was a mobile platform that communicated with an off-board PC. Its motion is controlled by the onboard programmable Pic18F97J60 microcontroller. 

Two PIC18F2331  microcontrollers were used for controlling two D.C. Servo Motors with incremental encoder feedback. This robot had an LCD Display, Battery Source, Ethernet Interface to Computer from main microcontroller card and Remote  Monitoring. 

I did the challenging job of designing its mechanical systems. I also successfully controlled its motion by devising a suitable algorithm and programmed them in-circuit debugger with microchip MPLAB ICD2.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Sical Logistics Ltd., founded in 1955 and with revenues in excess of Rs. 800 Cr., is India’s leading integrated logistics solutions provider with over 5 decades of experience in providing end to end logistics solutions. In 2011 Sical was acquired by the Rs. 4000 Cr. Coffee Day group, one of India’s fastest growing business conglomerates with interests ranging from coffee plantations and agri-businesses, commodity exports, stakeholdings in leading IT and embedded technology companies, real estate and hospitality.While traditionally known for its stevedoring, customs handling, trucking and steamer agency businesses, Sical today has made significant investments in logistics related infrastructure and operates mechanized Port terminals (container and bulk), container freight stations, container rakes, rail and road terminals. In addition to above Sical also provides offshore support services to the oil and gas industry and owns and operates a 2006 built cutter suction dredger.At Sical every aspect of logistics namely port handling, road and rail transport, warehousing, shipping etc.  are  combined as an integrated logistics solutions and tailored to meet individual client needs.This is aided by investments in state of the art Infrastructure, equipments and handling facilities to provide Cargo handling efficiency. Sical also offers comprehensive custom made yet cost effective solutions depending on specific needs enhancing flexibility, safety and reliability norms.Handling more than 26 million tons of bulk and over 0.5 million TEUS of container cargo annually Sical is one of the few ‘Made in India’ organizations with a strong network having independent operations countrywide. The success mantra is based on creating right process, investing in right infrastructure, recruiting and nourishing capability of employees, constant training and exemplary business ethics.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Techspardha is the national level inter-collegiate technical and entrepreneurship festival organized every year by National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra. Since its humble inception in 1995 as Literati (as it was formerly called) with the noble goal of enhancing the technical aptitude and scientific acumen of students, Techspardha has witnessed tremendous growth with an annual footfall of over 6000 students from all over India.Etymologically, the word ‘Techspardha’ is composed of two words, ‘Tech’ in English which is a contraction for technology and ‘Spardha’ in Hindi means competition. Thus, it signifies technological empowerment through healthy concurs and tournaments.

Vision 1. Using technology to improve healthcare access2. Make healthcare affordable to ensure universal reach3. Create a system of continuous improvement by fostering a 360 degree cycle of data collection, intervention and feedback.Set up in 2010, Glocal is a bold attempt to redefine healthcare. It focuses on understanding the problems of healthcare, designs solutions & implements them. It is an integrated healthcare player from primary, secondary to tertiary healthcare; from brick & mortar to virtual; from skills to technology to infra to delivery – Glocal does it all.Glocal currently runs as many as ten hospitals across Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal and Odisha, bringing state-of-the-art medical facilities, infrastructure along with technology and skills closer to the under-served India.The hospitals run on a process based & outcome oriented system, providing outstanding medical services at a price point that provides maximum access to the intended audience. Apart from Hospitals, Glocal Healthcare has come up with Digital Dispensaries in a bid to solve the problem of primary healthcare in underserved regions of India. Capable of running a hospital sans surgery, Digital Dispensary is a wonder in itself.A Digital Dispensary or a hospital in a box is an innovative brick and mortar centre which aims at providing complete primary and emergency healthcare solution such as consultation, confirmatory tests, and medicines from a single point. It is a path-breaking innovation which lets us parade into the world of tomorrow. So far Glocal has been operating more than 130 Digital dispensaries in Rajasthan, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Manipur and West Bengal. In addition to a government-sponsored model, Glocal has now decided to launch the entrepreneurship model to expand the reach of healthcare to the un-served and the under-served.

basic_profile.name: Milind Sharma
basic_profile.headline: SVP at Delhivery
basic_profile.summary:
Entrepreneurial operator with 15+ years of experience building and scaling businesses across e-commerce, quick commerce and logistics.

I currently lead the Express Parcel business at Delhivery, enabling e-commerce companies to reach customers across India through a fast, reliable and efficient logistics network.

Previously co-founded PepperTap, where I led business strategy and expansion, scaling the hyperlocal grocery platform to $200M+ ARR and raising $50M from investors including Sequoia, Elevation, Snapdeal, RTP Global and Beenext.

At Nuvo Logistics, I led business and operations, scaling the company to $10M+ revenue across 75+ cities before its acquisition by Shadowfax.

Earlier at Delhivery, as part of the early team, I helped scale the business from 0 to 100K daily orders, leading business development and key partnerships. I later joined Shadowfax, where I led growth and strategic initiatives.

Most recently, I co-founded Flyo (quick commerce) and Mabel (jewelry commerce), raising ~$2.5M from investors including Whiteboard, Sauce VC and Incubate Fund.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Shadowfax is building the infrastructure behind India's fast-moving commerce economy.For over 11 years, we have enabled businesses to move faster, reach further, and serve customers better. Today, leading brands including Nykaa, Myntra, AJIO, Meesho, Mokobara, and Dot & Key rely on Shadowfax to power deliveries across the country.As consumer expectations continue to evolve, speed has become a defining force in commerce. Shadowfax enables businesses to meet those expectations through a technology-driven logistics platform built on scale, reliability, and operational excellence.From same-day and next-day delivery to 30-minute hyperlocal fulfilment, express parcel, reverse logistics, and supply chain solutions, we support the full spectrum of modern commerce. Whether enabling rapid deliveries for quick commerce brands or helping enterprises serve customers across India, our platform is built to move commerce at speed.Our network spans 15,656+ PIN codes across India and is powered by 2.6 lakh+ quarterly delivery partners, 3,500+ trucks, and 4.7 million+ square feet of operational infrastructure. It is the infrastructure that powers growth, shapes customer experience, and keeps commerce moving. Through technology, intelligent automation, sustainable mobility, and relentless execution, we are building the future of commerce movement in India.Because commerce moves at Shadowfax speed.

past.employee_description:

Overlooked Business Expansion, Growth & Marketing and Strategy functions.

We were the 3rd biggest grocery e-tailer in India at the time of pivot.

basic_profile.name: Rahul Singhani

basic_profile.summary: As Director of Product Management at Delhivery, I own two critical charters: client experience (including client onboarding funnel) and AI-powered value-added services. I currently operate at the intersection of AI, logistics and product management.Outside of work, I like to run, cycle, read, and write.

Hero Motocorp Limited, Vadodara,Gujrat,India Sep’15 Present Green Field Project (Two Wheeler Manufacturing Plant) Team Manager- (Operations - Frame assembly)
• Responsible for planning and establishing the assembly lines for various production levels with a goal to implement a new product every financial quarter with a productivity target of atleast 5 vehicles per man at 18 second TAKT.
• Zero based manpower planning and recruitment to meet production ramp up from 0 vehicles per shift to 1400 vehicles per shift.
• Calculate and define manpower requirement in all direct and indirect areas of the plant
• Set targets for manpower productivity for the year by benchmarking other established Heromoto Corp plants, and monitor it on daily basis.
• Drive productivity improvement projects across the plant.
• Industrial Engineering MOST (Manyard Operation Sequence Technique): Estimation of work content through MOST (MINI + BASIC) and finalizing assembly / machining time.
• Line Balancing: Balancing of assembly line wrt time & implementation . Manpower Planning :Plan and deploy manpower in respective direct & indirect areas on the basis of work content estimation through the implementation of IE tools to meet production demands at optimised costs. Negotiations: Convincing Union representative for work content, line balancing & implementation. Productivity Improvement: Implementation of productivity improvement projects by using different industrial engineering tools like VA/NVA analysis, Heijunka, Yamazumi , Low Cost Automations (LCA’s)ect. Lean Manufacturing: Driving lean manufacturing initiative for plant by identifying projects through VSM (Value Stream Mapping) & other tools like JIT, KANBAN, Lead time reduction ect. Capacity Planning: Planning of production capacity & forecasting needs based on market demand.

basic_profile.summary: I am a logistics and supply chain leader with a passion for building, scaling, and transforming large-scale last-mile operations. current.employee_description: Own last-mile operations across three regions — 180+ DCs, ~275,000 shipments/day, and a 3,200+ member workforce (4 senior managers, 20 managers, 500+ on-roll staff, 2,700+ riders). Near-doubled network capacity: scaled Hyderabad 55→100 DCs (70K→160K daily), Pune 41→60 DCs (50K→85K), and Goa 15→22 DCs (14K→29K) — the latter against 30% migrant-rider inflow — capturing ~60% of Hyderabad’s B2C demand at best-in-class performance. Delivered ~₹25 crore in annual savings — cut fixed cost-per-shipment 17% and biker cost-per-shipment 10.5% across the three-region network. Sustained delivery SLAs of 90–92% across all three regions through demand–supply planning and capacity planning against sales forecasts. Absorbed festive-season peak surges of ~1.5x daily volume while holding SLA at 89% — the performance behind back-to-back “Best Director” awards. Drove Delhivery’s first full 0→100% regional EV transition (Pune) — owning charging-infra and rider retraining — cutting cost-per-vanday from ₹878 to ₹438 and overall cost-per-shipment from ₹42.9 to ₹12.8. Single-handedly built the STM real-time ops dashboard end-to-end — AI logic, analytics, and UX/UI — then handed it to product for launch; now the standard tool at every last-mile level, cutting forward & reverse aging 27%. Revamped the field-executive app (incentives, visibility, product-mix CPS tracking) and built MCDM performance scorecards, cutting rider churn 12%.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Shree Cement is one of India’s top three cement producers and among the country’s most respected names in the building materials industry.From a single plant in Beawar, Rajasthan, our journey of over four decades has grown into a diversified manufacturing footprint across India and the UAE, with cement capacity exceeding 70 MTPA. More than 62% of our electricity requirement is met through green sources, including Waste Heat Recovery, solar and wind energy, supported by a green power generation capacity of 634.5 MW. Creating possibilities for generations.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Maruti Suzuki was established with a dream to provide the 'Joy of Mobility' in the early 1980s. With a humble start of manufacturing about 20,000 cars in a year, the Company has grown leaps and bounds, manufacturing close to 2 million cars a year in FY 2022-23. Over the last four decades, the Company has served over 27 million happy customers in India and around 100 countries of the world. It maintained its market leadership in India throughout–reflecting the Company’s obsession with creating customer delight and demonstrating its agility to adapt to the changing times. This was possible by leveraging the unique ability of Suzuki Motor Corporation (parent company) to design feature-rich, safer, environment-friendly products, delivering world-class quality at an affordable price. In FY 2023-24, Maruti Suzuki embarked on an ambitious path in terms of manufacturing scale, while simultaneously transiting towards a low-carbon path. This marks a new phase for the Company.
past.employee_description:
Leadership Responsibilities
· Managed supplier operations for a ₹290 crore procurement portfolio across seven strategic vendors, consistently ensuring uninterrupted production and best-in-class supplier performance. 
· Led strategic sourcing, localization, supplier negotiations, and new product development across multiple vehicle platforms to improve cost competitiveness and supply reliability.
· Directed cost optimization initiatives through value engineering, supplier development, alternate sourcing, and localization programs.
· Mentored Graduate Engineer Trainees and coordinated cross-functional execution for six new vehicle launches, ensuring seamless communication between procurement, engineering, and manufacturing teams.
  
Key Achievements 
· Maintained 100% supplier delivery ratings with zero delivery defaults across all managed vendors.
· Delivered ₹50 million annual cost savings through commercial negotiations and supplier cost optimization initiatives.

· Localized jacks, tool kits, and imported components, delivering ₹6.17 million in recurring savings while strengthening supply continuity.
· Introduced alternate sourcing across 4 of 5 commodity categories, significantly reducing supplier dependency.
· Recommended value engineering, weight reduction, part commonization, and material optimization initiatives, with 90% of proposals approved, generating an additional ₹40 million in savings opportunities.
· Recognized with Achievement Awards for outstanding business contribution during FY2019 and FY2021.

Motherson is a diversified global design, engineering, manufacturing, assembly and logistics (D.E.M.A.L.) specialist, delivering full-system solutions to customers across a wide range of industries. With a robust network of 475+ state-of-the-art facilities across 47 countries, and a dedicated workforce of more than 205,000 professionals, Motherson is continually working toward its vision of being a globally preferred sustainable solutions provider for its stakeholders. The group recorded revenues of USD 22.9 billion in 2025-26 and is ranked among the top 15 automotive suppliers worldwide.As a trusted partner to OEM customers, Motherson offers an extensive, versatile product portfolio spanning the entire spectrum of the mobility industry. This includes passenger and commercial vehicles, two- and three-wheelers, rolling stock, off-highway vehicles, earthmoving, material-handling and agricultural machinery. Its product range encompasses electrical distribution systems, fully assembled vehicle interior and exterior modules, rear vision systems, moulded plastic parts and assemblies, injection moulding tools, rubber components, lighting systems, and machined metal products.Beyond the automotive sector, Motherson has strategically diversified into industries such as health and medical, aerospace, consumer electronics, logistics, and industrial IT solutions. This expansion reflects the group’s adaptability and unwavering commitment to meeting its customers' evolving needs.Motherson believes its employees are its partners in progress, its biggest asset. The organisation nurtures an environment where employees thrive as dynamic professionals and individuals. The organisation is responsive to its employees' professional aspirations and provides a range of growth opportunities, enabling them to advance professionally and to take on strategic roles within the organisation.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Cipla is a leading global pharmaceutical company trusted by healthcare professionals and patients across the world since 1935. A compassionate approach to healthcare that goes beyond the pursuit of profit and growth has been the force impelling Cipla’s history over the years.Our credo and our purpose of ‘Caring for Life' continues to guide our actions towards our people and the planet for creating a sustainable future. Cipla today has presence in 80+ countries, providing over 1,500 products across various therapeutic categories in 50+ dosage forms. Keeping with our legacy of care, we constantly strive to ensure access to high-quality medicines that make a difference in the lives of patients. Our paradigm-changing offer of a triple anti-retroviral (ARV) therapy in HIV/AIDS at less than a dollar a day in Africa in 2001 was pivotal in bringing inclusiveness, accessibility and affordability to the centre of the HIV movement. An unmatched presence across the care continuum (awareness, prevention, diagnosis, treatment and adherence) and the widest range of drug-device combinations has established Cipla’s respiratory leadership in India and other key emerging markets. Armed with this legacy and a deep understanding of the lungs, we have articulated our aspiration to become a global lung leader and help millions breathe free.

past.employer_linkedin_description: lifecare health (previously LifCare) is India’s largest Subscription pharmacy for chronic patients and is making chronic health management affordable and convenient for everyone. India has ~25% of its population suffering from chronic diseases and about 1/3 rd of this population does not adhere to its maintenance medicine - leading to hospitalization and sky-rocketing healthcare costs. We lost ~300,000 lives to Diabetes alone in 2015 due to non-adherence. We, at lifecare health, believe we can save these lives. We are redefining chronic disease management and the medicine supply chain using intelligent technology and data science that includes refills management, prescription digitization, offline to online shift, medicine reminders, intelligent warehouse stocking and smart logistics.Founded in late 2015 by a team consisting of IIT/IIM alumni having several years of industry experience in companies, lifecare health aims to enhance the whole pharmacy experience for patients by providing a relationship-oriented, technology-driven and convenient environment. From proactive monthly refills to updating dosages to making sure adherence improves, we at lifecare health take care of everything. We are an ideal healthcare center for patients on long duration medicines for Diabetes, Heart, Hypertension, Thyroid, Kidney disorders, etc. We are proud to be in an industry that can make a real difference to millions of lives! Write to us at care@lifcare.in or visit us at www.lifecarehealth.com to know more!

past.employer_linkedin_description: Manappuram Finance Ltd. is one of India’s largest and most trusted gold loan companies, with 4,199 branches across the length and breadth of the country. It currently has nearly Rs. 157.65 billion worth assets under management (AUM), and 20,185 employees.Promoted by Shri. V.P. Nandakumar, the current MD & CEO, the company was founded in the modest coastal village of Valapad (Thrissur District) by his late father Mr. V.C. Padmanabhan in 1949. The first non-banking financial company (NBFC) in Kerala to receive a Certificate of Registration issued by the RBI, it was also among the earliest to go for an IPO in 1995. In 2007 Sequoia Capital invested Rs.700 million along with Hudson Equity Holdings, heralding a period of accelerated growth, and in 2010 it became the first NBFC in Kerala to obtain the highest short term credit rating of A1+ from ICRA. In 2010, it became the first Kerala-based NBFC to offer ESOPs (Employee Stock Option Plan) to its middle and senior management functionaries.As a pioneer and trailblazer, Manappuram Finance Ltd. has always been an innovator par excellence in the gold loan product and the adoption of technology. Besides focus on the business, the cause of the wider community is central to the vision of the company. The Manappuram Foundation was established in October 2009 to drive the company’s initiatives in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).In recent years, the company has diversified into new business areas like micro-finance, vehicle and housing finance, and SME lending through the subsidiaries Manappuram Home Finance Ltd, Manappuram Insurance Brokers Ltd, and Asirvad Microfinance Limited.Our mission is to make life easy for common people of India with instant and easy loans, with a vision of unlocking the value of their savings in gold jewellery.

basic_profile.summary:
As the head of the data science team at one of India's largest tech enabled logistics provider, I am driven by high-impact problem-solving . In this role, I ensure my team delivers tangible and measurable outcomes, leveraging my diverse experience. My previous entrepreneurial ventures have equipped me with a broad skill set, from software development to product management and sales, allowing me to approach problems with a unique perspective.

My problem-solving approach is centered on usability and product relevance rather than purely on engineering. While I grasp the technical aspects, my focus is on answering critical questions about what to build, rather than how to build it. This involves identifying the right metrics, validating assumptions, evaluating cost-benefit and ROI, and discerning true user demand versus internal wishful thinking. These strategic decisions save resources, reduce frustration, and accelerate go-to-market timelines.

I continually refine my process through experience, cross-industry discussions, and learning from both successes and failures. My adaptable, Swiss-knife approach has enabled my team to achieve remarkable results in the logistics sector, both in India (#Bharat) and globally.

past.employer_linkedin_description: When we think music, we think Gaana.We are on our mission to simplify the way a billion users discover, consume and express not only music through innovation, culturally diverse content, and passionate people. basic_profile.name: Gourav Bhardwaj
basic_profile.headline: Human Resources Business Partner
basic_profile.summary:
I am an adaptable, resourceful, and enthusiastic individual with considerable experience in administrative work. I have excellent organizational skills and the ability to perform a variety of professional level MIS Operation functions for Staffing an organization that requires a range of knowledge and skills within my area of expertise also possess team working qualities that help me work together to achieve our goals at all times. 
To develop and establish my career as an efficient professional and to work with an organization that gives scope to update my knowledge and skills in order to achieve mutual growth and benefit. 

Recruitment & Selection: 
✅ Responsible for Recruitment, Selection & shortlisting the candidates. Sourcing the possible candidates via the sourcing procedures like job portals, walk-ins, and employees’ references, followed by screening and shortlisting of candidates. 
✅Conducting the first round of HR Interviews to evaluate communication, attitude, and commitment of the candidate towards the organization. Follow-up with the candidates till they joining 
Onboarding, Induction & Joining formalities: 
✅ Taking Induction sessions for the junior, Executive & Middle-level entrants in the Organization, Ensured induction of all employees as per the defined process. 
✅Manage business letters related to employee’s offer & appointment letter, service agreement, background verification, , allowances, request for evidence, transfer related documentation etc. 
Payroll Management: 
✅ Verify Time & Leave Management for timely and ensure accurate processing of the Monthly Payroll according to the schedule, Generating Pay slips and forwarding them to employees. 
✅ Manage regular preparation of relevant MIS reports, including weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end reports (gross payroll, hours worked, vacation accrual, tax deductions, benefit deductions, etc.) 
✅ Manage employee queries with regard to their deductions, settlements, and supporting their requirements. 
✅Strict adherence and compliances with the provisions of various Lab. our legislations (Shops Act, EPF, ESI, PT, etc.,) Registrations & Renewals, etc... 
✅P.F, E.S.I., P.T & Gratuity - Calculations, Remittances. 
✅Timely updating of Attendance & Leave Management in the HRIS System, verify & process record data of each employee for Gratuity, Mediclaim, and Insurance details. 
✅Part of HR Shared Services team for attending & assigning Internal / External Employees queries regards to onboarding, leave, payroll, F&F settlements, performance appraisals, etc.

basic_profile.summary: I scale B2B businesses. Over 23 years, I have owned P&L across logistics, telecom, and media - building teams, designing go-to-market strategies, and turning early-stage verticals into large, profitable franchises.  At Delhivery, I took the LTL/B2B business from a ₹125 Cr portfolio to a ₹550 Cr national mandate through three progressive leadership roles over five years. I built and led a pan-India organisation of 100+ people - Regional Directors, senior managers, and key account managers - across Focus, Strategic, and PSU account segments.  What I am most known for:→ Built Delhivery's PSU vertical from zero - designed the GTM, hired the team, and closed a ₹185 Cr partnership with HPCL, the largest deal in the company's history→ Secured multi-year enterprise contracts with Bosch, Maruti, 3M, ITC, and Daimler - displacing entrenched incumbents at scale  → Delivered 32% revenue growth at HT Media and exceeded 35% EBITDA margin with ₹40 Cr+ absolute profitability across 3 stations in West India→ Managed a ₹1,000 MN major accounts portfolio at Bharti Airtel - 65% revenue growth, highest in Mumbai circle → Ranked National No. 1 ASM at Reliance for three consecutive quarters and earned CEO Award, Annual Leadership Awards (2024 and 2025), and ITC's "Most Reliable PTL Partner" recognition at Delhivery → Guest faculty at IIM Jammu - conducted a session on "Understanding Logistics: The Journey from Warehouse to Delivery"  My operating strengths sit at the intersection of P&L ownership, B2B revenue strategy, GTM design, enterprise and CXO-level sales, strategic account management, new vertical creation, and cross-functional leadership across sales, operations, and customer success. I have consistently shifted teams from traditional selling to new-age, data-driven methods - and I build organisations that sustain growth beyond any one deal or quarter.  Committed to driving business transformation, accelerating profitable growth, and contributing at an enterprise level as I continue progressing toward CXO leadership.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

past.employer_linkedin_description: We are not just a brand.We are soil, seed, and stories.Earthy Tales is a farmer-first organic food company. We work with small farmers who still trust the earth more than chemicals. They grow fruits, vegetables, grains, and pulses the slow, honest way — in real mud, under real sun, with no poison sprays.Harvest samples are frequently lab-tested so your food is as clean as we can make it. If it is not safe for our own families, it does not leave the farm.We cut out the middlemen and the middle noise. We build fair partnerships with farmers and deliver their harvest straight to conscious homes. When you buy from Earthy Tales, your money doesn’t disappear into a delivery app — it reaches the hands that grew your food.Big apps may show you an “organic” label. But they hide the real faces and real fields behind that word. We exist so those faces stay seen, valued, and supported.Our mission is simple:clean food, healthy homes, and a fair life for the farmers who feed us.You decide what survives — shortcuts or soil.Every order is a vote.Every meal is a message.If you want your food to have a name, a face, and a future — Earthy Tales is where your plate and the farmer’s story finally meet.

basic_profile.headline: Vice President -  Delhivery, IIM Lucknow .
basic_profile.summary:
In an experience of more than 27years, I have achieved success in building profitable organizations, delivering competitive edge for revenue growth in start-up, mature and turnaround environments, strengthening operational excellence, and setting up scalable infrastructure from scratch for sales, marketing and distribution channels. 

I have headed large-scale business operations, developed and launched pioneering products, improved brand value, achieved leadership position in market share, driven growth to generate annual turnover in excess of INR 4500 crore (USD 60+ million), and increased margins in highly competitive markets.

Colleagues and business partners acknowledge me as an inspirational leader, value creator and business strategist, adept at adjusting quickly to challenges, leveraging business opportunities, and dealing effectively with key stakeholders.

Highlights:

At Aircel, I developed and led high-performing teams of up to 1000 people, established efficient technical, operational and manpower capabilities, built new business and distribution networks from the ground up, and turned around operations from EBITDA loss of INR 400 crore to EBITDA profit of INR 100+ crore within 2 years. At present I am heading the Wireless Business for West Region Circle.
While with Vodafone, I doubled the top line in one year, achieved market leadership position, and increased the subscriber base by penetrating new markets.

Specialities: 

P&L Management | Business Planning | Business Development | Go-to-market | Brand & Product Portfolio Management | Channel Partner Management | Budget & Margin Management | Post-M&A Integration | Team Building

past.employer_linkedin_description: *This page is run by ex-Employees of Aircel, as a platform to keep in touch and share memories. We do not provide any support or services to ex-customers of Aircel.*Aircel Ltd. was an Indian mobile network operator headquartered in Mumbai that offered voice and 2G and 3G data services. Maxis Communications held a 74% stake and Sindya Securities and Investments held the remaining 26%.Aircel was founded by Chinnakannan Sivasankaran and commenced operations in Tamil Nadu in 1999. It was once a market leader in Tamil Nadu and had considerable presence in Odisha, Assam and North-East telecom circles. 2G and 3G Services including voice were shut down in all circles after failure of merger talks with Reliance Communications.As of December 2017, Aircel had a subscriber base of over 84.93 million and was India's sixth-largest GSM mobile service provider.[24] With presence in 22 circles, Aircel was a market leader in Tamil Nadu and had considerable presence in Odisha, Assam and North-East circles. In 2012, as a part of a major re-organization in its operations, the company scaled down its operations in five telecom circles, namely Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Haryana, Kerala and Punjab. In April 2015, Aircel relaunched its service in Kerala.Now Aircel is under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process From 12 March 2018.Aircel was the main shirt sponsor of Indian Premier League cricket team Chennai Super Kings and I-League football team Shillong Lajong FC. Aircel was also the principal sponsor for Atlético de Kolkata FC who play in the Indian Super League football competition. It was also a major sponsor of the Chennai Open ATP tennis tournament and the Professional Golf Tour of India. Aircel also sponsored the Save the Tiger campaign for protecting India's tigers. The brand ambassadors of Aircel included the Indian cricket team captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni and Tamil actor Suriya. Aircel also engaged with boxer Mary Kom, Tamil actors Dhanush and Sameera Reddy.

*This page is run by ex-Employees of Aircel, as a platform to keep in touch and share memories. We do not provide any support or services to ex-customers of Aircel.*Aircel Ltd. was an Indian mobile network operator headquartered in Mumbai that offered voice and 2G and 3G data services. Maxis Communications held a 74% stake and Sindya Securities and Investments held the remaining 26%.Aircel was founded by Chinnakannan Sivasankaran and commenced operations in Tamil Nadu in 1999. It was once a market leader in Tamil Nadu and had considerable presence in Odisha, Assam and North-East telecom circles. 2G and 3G Services including voice were shut down in all circles after failure of merger talks with Reliance Communications.As of December 2017, Aircel had a subscriber base of over 84.93 million and was India's sixth-largest GSM mobile service provider.[24] With presence in 22 circles, Aircel was a market leader in Tamil Nadu and had considerable presence in Odisha, Assam and North-East circles. In 2012, as a part of a major re-organization in its operations, the company scaled down its operations in five telecom circles, namely Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Haryana, Kerala and Punjab. In April 2015, Aircel relaunched its service in Kerala.Now Aircel is under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process From 12 March 2018.Aircel was the main shirt sponsor of Indian Premier League cricket team Chennai Super Kings and I-League football team Shillong Lajong FC. Aircel was also the principal sponsor for Atlético de Kolkata FC who play in the Indian Super League football competition. It was also a major sponsor of the Chennai Open ATP tennis tournament and the Professional Golf Tour of India. Aircel also sponsored the Save the Tiger campaign for protecting India's tigers. The brand ambassadors of Aircel included the Indian cricket team captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni and Tamil actor Suriya. Aircel also engaged with boxer Mary Kom, Tamil actors Dhanush and Sameera Reddy.

The Indian Army is the largest branch of the Indian Armed Forces and is responsible for land-based military operations. Its primary mission is the National Security and Defense of India from external aggression and threats, and maintaining peace and security within its borders. It also conducts humanitarian rescue operations during natural calamities and other disturbances. The Indian Army is one of the three services under the Ministry of Defence.The President of India is the Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Armed Forces, and thus of the Indian Army. The highest ranking military officer is the Chief of Army Staff (COAS), who is also a member of the Chiefs of Staff Committee.The Indian Army came into being at the Independence of India in 1947, and inherited most of the regiments and infrastructure of the British Indian Army that were located in post-partition India.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Government of India is responsible for ensuring the defence of India and every part thereof. The Supreme Command of the Armed Forces vests in the President. The responsibility for national defence rests with the Cabinet. This is discharged through the Ministry of Defence, which provides the policy framework and wherewithal to the Armed Forces to discharge their responsibilities in the context of the defence of the country. The Raksha Mantri (Defence Minister) is the head of the Ministry of Defence. The principal task of the Defence Ministry is to obtain policy directions of the Government on all defence and security related matters and communicate them for implementation to the Services Headquarters, Inter-Services Organisations, Production Establishments and Research and Development Organisations. It is also required to ensure effective implementation of the Government's policy directions and the execution of approved programmes within the allocated resources. Ministry of Defence comprises of four Departments viz. Department of Defence (DOD), Department of Defence Production  (DDP), Department of Defence Research & Development (DDR&D) and Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare and also Finance Division.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Last mile delivery in supply chain management and transportation planning, is the last leg of a journey comprising the movement of people and goods from a transportation hub to a final destination.
past.employee_description:
Handling last-mile operations:

* On-time delivery rate:  The percentage of deliveries completed within the promised timeframe.
* Delivery cost per order:  The average cost of delivering a single order.
* Customer satisfaction:  A measure of customer happiness with the delivery experience.
* First-mile delivery time:  The time it takes to get the order from the warehouse to the delivery vehicle.
* Average delivery time:  The average time it takes to deliver an order to the customer.
* Number of delivery attempts:  The number of times a delivery driver needs to attempt to deliver an order.
* Delivery route efficiency:  A measure of how efficiently delivery routes are planned and executed.
* Driver performance:  A measure of driver productivity and adherence to company policies.
* Delivery failure rate:  The percentage of deliveries that fail to be completed successfully.
* Return rate:  The percentage of orders that are returned after delivery.
* Order fulfillment rate:  The percentage of orders that are fulfilled and delivered on time.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

past.employer_linkedin_description: Voted as 'India's Most Trusted Apparel Retail Brand,' (Brand Equity Survey 2014/2015), Pantaloons, a division of ABFRL has always been one of the most loved large format fashion retailers in India.Post-acquisition by Aditya Birla Nuvo Limited in 2013, Pantaloons is today the fastest growing large format retailer in the country. The rate of new store openings has increased from one every two months to one every two weeks.The company offers a wide range of brand offerings across apparel and non-apparel categories and across varied price points.It operates across categories of casual wear, ethnic wear, formal wear, party wear and active wear for men, women and kids. Womenswear is the lead category contributing to half of total apparel sales. Non-apparel products include footwear, handbags, cosmetics, perfumes, fashion jewellery and watches.Post-acquisition by the Aditya Birla Group, significant investments were made focused on store upgradation, expansion, deeper pan-India penetration, portfolio enrichment, brand building and organisation processes to lay the foundation for its future growth. The brand is now present in 78 Indian cities / towns.Pantaloons began in 1997 as a Future Group company in the quest to equip the emerging Indian middle-class with an indigenous fashion retail format. Consistent with the times, the model was of a discount fashion retailer.

Etched with a strong value system to serve the needy, Mercy Hospital strikes a perfect balance to expand its exemplary work in changing the healthcare industry.Post its inception in the year 1977, Mercy is a leading healthcare organization with its presence in West Bengal, Odisha, and Jharkhand. The hospital has aligned itself in the process to spread healthcare to the remotest areas of the state.We have dedicated team of doctors, nurses and partners, with long standing well wishers and education based institutions from all across the globe.

past.employer_linkedin_description: TalentPad is a unique online platform having the promise to disrupt the hiring industry, currently governed by traditional channels like job-boards and recruitment agencies. They're a marketplace connecting high quality talent with technology companies through a unique concept of a TalentFair. TalentFair is basically a week long online event, conducted periodically, which sees participation of high quality candidates and hundreds of employers across a selected few roles.They act as a platform for the candidate to showcase his profile to hundreds of employers in a week, and in the process get multiple interview opportunities with upfront compensation and other details. Post that the candidate decides where to interview, and gets hired in a matter of days. The nature of the marketplace ensures that he gets to explore the market fairly well, thus receiving the best opportunity from the market.
past.employee_description:
TalentPad was a second generation recruiting marketplace powered by technology and data-science with efficient "matching" being the differentiator. Improved matching was led by capturing detailed structured data-sets, using heuristics and data science to efficiently match employers with potential pre-screened potential candidates, while taking into account subjective preferences and biases of employers.

At Talentpad, we achieved some significant milestones in a short span of time.
•	Partnered with more than 1500+ companies and scaled the business to a revenue run-rate of a $1million.
•	Funded by Helion Ventures, TalentPad was awarded as the "Most innovative startup" in the recruiting space at the HR Tech conference in 2014.

As Co-Founder and CTO, I owned Technology and Product functions, and was instrumental in
•	Building first version of product from scratch alone
•	Building a team of 12 exceptionally talented engineers and designers with great past experiences
•	Integration of acquired assessment platform OptimizedBits in early 2015.

Trevo plans to make your daily travel much more convenient, reliable and hassle-free. 

Today either there are low-cost public transport options like the bus / metros which cost < Rs 2 /km, but are extremely uncomfortable and overcrowded, or at the other spectrum there are door-to-door options like Uber / UberPool, which are convenient but heavy on the pocket (i.e. > Rs 10-15 /km), to be used for daily use. Auto are in the middle, which are somewhat convenient but again decently expensive (~Rs 10 /km). There is a huge gap in between, a massive market to be addressed. 

Trevo is a network of private buses and mini-buses, which are highly convenient, predictable and reliable for your daily travel, maybe it be to your workplace or to your college or to your tuition class or whatsoever it maybe. It gives you the convenience to pre-book your seat, to track your bus in real-time, so now no waiting at the bus stop, enjoy your in-bus ride with value added services like free high-speed wifi, magazines / newspapers, charging stations, in-bus entertainment system, and of course a place to connect with your co-travellers.

We are a passionate bunch of entrepreneurs who aspire and will solve this problem using tech. and robust processes.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Navy is a well-balanced and cohesive three-dimensional force, capable of operating above, on and under the surface of the oceans, efficiently safeguarding our national interests.The Indian Navy is the naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Navy. The Chief of Naval Staff, a four-star admiral, commands the navy.The Indian Navy traces its origins back to the East India Company's Marine which was founded in 1612 to protect British merchant shipping in the region. In 1793, the East India Company established its rule over eastern part of the Indian subcontinent i.e. Bengal, but it was not until 1830 that the colonial navy was titled as His Majesty's Indian Navy. When India became a republic in 1950, the Royal Indian Navy as it had been named since 1934 was renamed to Indian Navy.The primary objective of the navy is to safeguard the nation's maritime borders, and in conjunction with other Armed Forces of the union, act to deter or defeat any threats or aggression against the territory, people or maritime interests of India, both in war and peace. Through joint exercises, goodwill visits and humanitarian missions, including disaster relief, Indian Navy promotes bilateral relations between nations.As of July 2017, Indian Navy has 67,228 personnel in service and has a fleet of 137 warships and 235 aircraft.[4][5][6] As of March 2018, the operational fleet consists of one aircraft carrier, one amphibious transport dock, eight landing ship tanks, eleven destroyers, thirteen frigates, one nuclear-powered attack submarine, one ballistic missile submarine, fourteen conventionally-powered attack submarines, twenty-two corvettes, one mine countermeasure vessel, four fleet tankers and various other auxiliary vessels.The Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) exercises operational and administrative control of the Indian Navy from the Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence (Navy).

DigiAlly is a financial infrastructure company that leverages AI-driven solutions to advance financial inclusion for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and mid-market companies. At its core, the platform provides an AI-powered trust score evaluating SMEs across credit, operational, and market risks – streamlining credit assessments for institutional lenders through unified risk quantification. This approach replaces fragmented evaluation methods with a holistic view of business viability.The platform tackles information asymmetry between SMEs and corporations by integrating nontraditional data points – including supply chain interactions, digital transaction patterns, and market positioning metrics – alongside conventional financial indicators. Through proprietary machine learning models, DigiAlly’s API solution also enables real-time portfolio monitoring and predictive risk analytics, allowing lenders to dynamically adjust credit terms and optimize collection strategies as market conditions evolve.Key benefits include reduced reliance on backward-looking financial statements, expanded credit access for businesses lacking formal credit histories, and scalable infrastructure for lenders to grow SME portfolios profitably. Early adopters report 40% faster credit decision cycles and 25% reductions in default rates compared to traditional underwriting models, according to pilot data from partner institutions.DigiAlly’s risk assessment framework now extends beyond lending to address third-party risks across industries. Payment processors use the platform to evaluate merchant viability, while logistics firms apply it to assess supply chain partners’ operational resilience. This expansion reflects growing recognition that AI-powered trust metrics can mitigate counterparty risks in B2B transactions. By transforming opaque business relationships into data-driven partnerships, the platform aims to redefine how enterprises collaborate in the trust-based digital economy.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

Mr. Sushil Kumar had dreamt of venturing into Entertainment/Cable industry and they joined hands and hence the plan was given shape in the form of DARSH DIGITAL NETWORK PVT. LTD. (DDNPL) established on 13th Aug. 2008 and gained massive popularity within a very short period i.e. approx. 4 years by covering a maximum area of entire Bihar which gradually became the biggest Cable Network. As the time elapsed a strong need was felt for a Hindi News Channel which could deliver Local & Regional News. By this time Darsh Music, Darsh Entertainment & Darsh Cinema (three already successfully running Channel of DDNPL) had already gained enough popularity and only thing missing was a News Channel which emerged in the form of Darsh News. So, an initiative was taken to launch an Infotainment Channel of Bihar. The Channel is broadcasted 24 * 7 with true and current news running every hour as well as variety of Programs such as Aap Ki Rasoi, Cinema Aap Aur Hum, Darsh Talkies, Dil Ki Baat, Fashion Ka Jalwa, Rang Tarang etc. to cater the need of diversified group of viewers. Darsh News was on Test Signal from 20th November 2009 and was finally launched on 14th March 2010 by his Excellency Governor of Bihar, Mr. Devanand Kunwar along with the Honorable Chief Minister of Bihar Mr. Nitish Kumar. The other key invitees were Ravi Kishan, Shweta Tiwari, Debojeet, Anwesha & and Broadcasters of several leading Channels were also present in the launching ceremony.

BYJU’S is a global ed-tech company, providing highly adaptive, engaging and effective learning solutions to more than 150 million students around the world. Founded in India in 2011, BYJU’S mission is to make high-quality learning accessible to students everywhere.The BYJU’S family of brands includes Disney-BYJU’S Early Learn, BYJU’S Future School, Epic!, Osmo, Tynker, Toppr and WhiteHat Jr, along with our beloved flagship product BYJU’S – The Learning App. Together, BYJU’S solutions support Pre-K – 12 education and a wide range of competitive exams. BYJU’S delivers a world-class learning experience with tools that sit at the cross-section of mobile, interactive content and personalized learning methodologies. BYJU’S geography-agnostic solutions and 12,000+ teachers make learning engaging, with visual and contextual programs that adapt to the unique learning style, skill level and pace of each student. In addition, we have innovative partnerships with some of the world’s leading companies, including Disney and Google, to drive engagement and help even more students become active and lifelong learners. BYJU’S is backed by blue-chip investors including the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Sequoia Capital, Bond Capital, Silver Lake, BlackRock, Sands Capital Management, Alkeon Capital Management, Sofina, Verlinvest, Tencent, Prosus (previously Naspers Ventures), CPPIB, General Atlantic, Tiger Global, Qatar Investment Authority, Owl Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Times Internet, Aarin Capital and IFC. Since 2017, we have completed more than 15 acquisitions, including companies in the U.S., UK, Austria, India and Singapore. A 2021 Time 100 Most Influential Company, BYJU’S is headquartered in India, with operations in more than 21 countries globally and learning programs in multiple languages. For additional information, please visit www.byjus.com.

Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) traces its origin to the formative years of an emerging nation - India. After independence, the steel sector was to propel the economic growth and rapid industrialization of the country, and since 1973, SAIL steel has played a pivotal role in transforming the nation. SAIL is the largest steel-making company in India and one of the seven Maharatna’s of the country’s Central Public Sector Enterprises. We produce top quality steel and iron at five integrated plants and three special steel plants, located principally in the eastern and central regions of India and situated close to domestic sources of raw materials. We manufacture and sell a broad range of steel products which are high in demand in the domestic as well as international market. Technical knowledge upgrades leading through engineering approach to tackle daily job works and problem solving.
Study of Cement grinding process and its components
•	Cement Mill (Ball Mill)
•	O-Separator
•	Truck Tippler
Material transportation system according to the particle size.
Study of hydraulic circuits and its components functionality
•	Hydraulic pump
•	Hydraulic oil
•	Valves (Pressure control, Flow control)
•	Reservoirs
Equipment specific knowledge upgrades through RCFA study.
Work-force management and inventory management with respect to planned jobs execution requirements.
Projects Undertaken:
•	Installation and commissioning of Ball rolling Mill (BRM-120(10)) for the pulverization of Pet coke and coal.
•	Conversion of Reverse Air Bag House (RABH) to Pulse Jet Bag Filter (PJBF).

Mayank has also focused on industrial Safety elements. He is one of the key member of Pyramid Block B-12- Safe working Procedures. He has undergone safety training on following modules:
•	JSA & HIRA
•	Confined Space
•	Work at Height
•	Hot Work
•	Isolation and Lockout
•	Hazardous material Handling
•	On-site emergency plan execution.

Mayank has also been nominated as “Safety ambassador”. 
His key responsibilities include:
•	To improve OH&S performance leading and lagging indicators through reporting.
•	Display visual control, signage and SOP/SWP.
•	To impart safety tool talks on regular basis.  

Extracurricular activities:
Apart from the routine jobs, my organization also motivates its employees to take part in extra-curricular activities. 
•	Led the team as Captain and won Ambuja Volleyball tournament’2015.
•	Working as “Event Organizer” in the Ambuja Recreational club.

Incorporated in 1974, NFL is India's largest CPSE in Fertilizer Sector with a turnover of over Rs. 90 billion. It is the second largest producer of the key fertiliser Urea in India with an installed capacity of 35.68 Lakh MT with a 16% share in total urea production of country. NFL operates five gas based Ammonia-Urea plants viz Nangal & Bathinda in Punjab, Panipat in Haryana and two plants at Vijaipur (Madhya Pradesh) and a Bio-fertilizers plant in Vijaipur. The company has recently started production of Bentonite Sulphur at its Panipat Unit. NFL is engaged in manufacturing and marketing of Neem Coated Urea, four strains of Bio-Fertilizers (solid & liquid) and other allied Industrial products like Ammonia, Nitric Acid, Ammonium Nitrate, Sodium Nitrite and Sodium Nitrate. The brand name of the company is popularly known in the market as ‘KISAN’. The company has also started production of certified seeds under its flagship Seeds Multiplication Program.Apart from manufacturing business, the company is trading various agro-inputs like imported Non-Urea Fertilizers, certified seeds, Agro chemicals, City compost through its existing pan India dealer’s network under single window concept.NFL Marketing Network comprises of Central Marketing Office at NOIDA, four Zonal Offices at Bhopal, Lucknow & Chandigarh and Hyderabad, 16 State & 2 UT Offices and 35 Area offices spread across the marketing territory of NFL.The company is also playing a pivotal role in extending various agricultural extension services such as educating the farmers on judicious use of fertilizers along with total know-how on improved and scientific methods of cultivation to improve soil productivity. NFL in a JV with M/s EIL and M/s FCIL is setting up a state of the art 12.70 Lakh MT Urea Plant at Ramagundam in Telangana and also looking forward for expansion of its footprints globally by setting up the fertilizer plants. The company has a well-trained manpower of around 3500 employees.

With over 100 mn downloads, the OYO App was the 3rd most downloaded travel app in 2020. OYO Wizard, OYO’s loyalty program, has 9.2 million members and is the second largest loyalty program run by a travel or food brand in India, by subscriber base.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the space agency of the Government of India headquartered in the city of Bengaluru. Our vision is to "harness space technology for national development", while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration. ISRO is managed by the Department of Space (DoS) of the Government of India.Indian Space Research Organisation, formed in 1969, superseded the erstwhile INCOSPAR. ISRO is one of the six largest space agencies in the world. ISRO maintains one of the largest fleet of communication satellites (INSAT) and remote sensing (IRS) satellites, that cater to the ever growing demand for fast and reliable communication and earth observation respectively. ISRO develops and delivers application specific satellite products and tools to the Nation: broadcasts, communications, weather forecasts, disaster management tools, Geographic Information Systems, cartography, navigation, telemedicine, dedicated distance education satellites being some of them. The PSLV was developed as a cost efficient and reliable launch system which went on to become a favoured carrier for satellites of various countries due to its reliability and cost efficiency, promoting unprecedented international collaboration. The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) was developed keeping in mind the heavier and more demanding Geosynchronous communication satellites.Future readiness is the key to maintaining an edge in technology and ISRO endeavours to optimise and enhance its technologies as the needs and ambitions of the country evolve. Thus, ISRO is moving forward with the development of heavy lift launchers, human spaceflight projects, reusable launch vehicles, semi-cryogenic engines, single and two stage to orbit (SSTO and TSTO) vehicles, development and use of composite materials for space applications etc.

Main contribution here was identifying the initial 2000+ alternative variables for the cashflow based alternative lending single-handedly and building the analytical framework. Earlier experience as CFO with an insight into the fact that bank statement is a good proxy to a single entry accounting book as well as having used analytics in earlier stints was quite instrumental in developing this model using variables which were significantly quantitative in nature.
 
As COO in the initial years, I was responsible for setting up processes in functions like Credit, Risk, Product, Analytics, Collections, HR and Finance. Developed the first business plan for the company. Developed the Alternative Credit Risk Management framework and effectively serving as the Risk Officer as well. 

January 2017 onwards I also worked as CEO at Lendingkart Finance Limited (NBFC arm of Lendingkart Group) overseeing all the functions like Credit, Risk, Collections, HR, Finance,  Analytics, Product as well as Tech, and delivering one of the best financial performances in the fintech sector in FY 2018-2019, with a Revenue of INR 225 cr and PBT of INR 31cr in the NBFC. I had nine(9) function heads/CXOs reporting into me, namely the CBO, CTO, CPO, CAO, CFO, Head of Credit, Head of Risk, Head of HR, Head of Collections. It was this splendid team through the targets were achieved.

Contributed immensely to fund raises - especially Series B (USD 20mn) and Series C2 (USD 75mn) fund raises for the company and big ticket debt raises through investor interactions and delivery of exceptional credit performance.

Lendingkart was ranked 23rd among top 100 fintech innovators globally in the 2016 and 2018 KPMG Fintech 100 report and has been ranked 33rd globally in 2017 report and was highest ranked fintech lending company from India to be part of the top 50 list.

past.employer_linkedin_description: OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and Southeast Asia.OYO was founded by 27-year-old Ritesh Agarwal, the first Asian resident to be accepted to the Thiel Fellowship (started by Paypal founder Peter Thiel).OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points. Owners and operators of over 157K storefronts use the OYO platform to manage all mission-critical aspects of their business operations. OYO’s comprehensive, full-stack technology suite integrates more than 40 products and services across digital sign-up and onboarding, revenue management, daily business management and D2C stacks into two flagship patron applications, Co-OYO and OYO OS. OYO customers can book storefronts through OYO’s own D2C channels and through indirect channels with third-party OTAs. The OYO App offers a variety of digital tools to guide customers throughout their journey, including discovery, seamless booking, pre-stay assistance, cancellations, digital check-ins as well as in-stay and post-stay services. With over 100 mn downloads, the OYO App was the 3rd most downloaded travel app in 2020. OYO Wizard, OYO’s loyalty program, has 9.2 million members and is the second largest loyalty program run by a travel or food brand in India, by subscriber base.

past.employer_linkedin_description: P&G was founded more than 185 years ago as a soap and candle company. The design, development, growth and success of these products—and many more—is thanks to the innovative and insightful minds of our people. From Day 1, you’ll help make everyday life easier for our 5 billion consumers.  There is no single equation for success at P&G, because no two P&G people or careers are alike. Join us and help make life better through meaningful work that makes an impact from Day 1.

past.employer_linkedin_description: We are a London born brand that has a passion for crafting beautiful handbags and accessories that women love. Our approach is simple – to create the perfect combination of style on the outside and functionality on the inside. To achieve this we blend creative design, quality materials and immaculate craftsmanship, not forgetting plenty of personality to finish.Radley has come a long way since starting our handbag journey as part of a wave of new creatives setting up businesses in Camden Market in the midst of the 1980s. Driven by a passion for colour, luxurious leathers and FUN, Radley launched in 1998. Our spirit of playful creativity has remained at the heart of our design process ever since.Our Radley dog was born after a search was started for an icon to represent the playful personality of our brand. The very British looking Scottie, with his distinctive outline and bright red collar was a small idea sketched by our designers and proved to be a huge success – dog lovers all over the world fell for him just like we did!YOUR CAREER Here at Radley we’re proud of our fun-loving, friendly environment at our London Head Office and in our beautiful retail stores. Our working week is as fun and colourful as the handbags and accessories we sell and we’re always on the lookout for ambitious, talented people to join the Radley family. Each and every member of our business is a Brand Ambassador, striving to provide excellent customer experience in everything they do. As a key part of our success, you’ll be provided with ample opportunities for career development, as well as a competitive benefits package and a generous holiday entitlement. If you’ve seen a job you’re suited to, drop us a line – we can’t wait to hear from you!
past.employee_description:
The objective of the project was to examine whether the operations of two warehouses of Radley+Co could be consolidated into one which required:
•Planning base of future warehouse activity (based on Radley's business plan).
•Review of alternative approaches to accommodate the combined operations onto one site (e.g. equipment changes, building extension, etc).
•High-level cost benefit analysis (taking into account rental costs, equipment costs, staff costs, transport costs, etc – based on cost estimates supplied by Radley and alternatives supplied by student group).
•Sensitivity analysis based on varying future business scenarios.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Navy is a well-balanced and cohesive three-dimensional force, capable of operating above, on and under the surface of the oceans, efficiently safeguarding our national interests.The Indian Navy is the naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Navy. The Chief of Naval Staff, a four-star admiral, commands the navy.The Indian Navy traces its origins back to the East India Company's Marine which was founded in 1612 to protect British merchant shipping in the region. In 1793, the East India Company established its rule over eastern part of the Indian subcontinent i.e. Bengal, but it was not until 1830 that the colonial navy was titled as His Majesty's Indian Navy. When India became a republic in 1950, the Royal Indian Navy as it had been named since 1934 was renamed to Indian Navy.The primary objective of the navy is to safeguard the nation's maritime borders, and in conjunction with other Armed Forces of the union, act to deter or defeat any threats or aggression against the territory, people or maritime interests of India, both in war and peace. Through joint exercises, goodwill visits and humanitarian missions, including disaster relief, Indian Navy promotes bilateral relations between nations.As of July 2017, Indian Navy has 67,228 personnel in service and has a fleet of 137 warships and 235 aircraft.[4][5][6] As of March 2018, the operational fleet consists of one aircraft carrier, one amphibious transport dock, eight landing ship tanks, eleven destroyers, thirteen frigates, one nuclear-powered attack submarine, one ballistic missile submarine, fourteen conventionally-powered attack submarines, twenty-two corvettes, one mine countermeasure vessel, four fleet tankers and various other auxiliary vessels.The Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) exercises operational and administrative control of the Indian Navy from the Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence (Navy).
