past.employer_linkedin_description: Established in 1964, BHEL is one of India's largest engineering and manufacturing enterprises in the energy and infrastructure sectors, and a leading power equipment manufacturer globally. BHEL serves the core sectors of the economy and provides a comprehensive portfolio of products, systems and services to customers in power, transmission, transportation, renewables, water, defence & aerospace, oil & gas, and industry. BHEL has created value for its stakeholders due to the scale and depth of its operations, rich experience, competent manpower, innovative ecosystem, diverse product-mix and focus on sustainable business solutions. BHEL’s greatest asset- its highly skilled and committed workforce of more than 34,000 employees is the cornerstone of its success.BHEL’s commitment to nation building reflects in many ways- in its contribution to the country’s installed power generation capacity; bringing the latest state-of-the-art technology to the country; consistent highest expenditure of more than 2.5% of its turnover on R&D and innovation in the Indian engineering segment; pan-India presence; establishment of world-class assets with presence in over 84 country across the globe, and contribution to the society at large through initiatives in skilling youth, health & hygiene, education, cleanliness and environment protection, to name a few.With a widespread network of 16 manufacturing facilities, 2 repair units, 4 regional offices, 8 service centres, 1 subsidiary, 3 active joint ventures, 15 regional marketing centres, 3 overseas offices and current project execution at more than 150 project sites across India and abroad, BHEL manufactures a wide range of high quality & reliable products adhering to national & international standards. BHEL has installed over 1000 utility sets worldwide with its installed base of supplied power generating equipment exceeding 185 GW. BHEL has also commissioned 200+ electric substations & 5 major HVDC projects in the country.

Founded in 2015, Shuttl is India’s largest office commute service provider. With a mission of solving the pain of commute, Shuttl offers a space-efficient, safe, and cost-effective solution for urban India.Shuttl has demonstrated the ability to simultaneously address the dual challenge of congestion and pollution. The company catalyzes a shift away from private vehicles towards shared mobility - a win-win for citizens and cities. It also drives entrepreneurship by providing bus-owners on its platform with the latest technology, better financing, and relevant training, to help them scale and participate in offering a smarter, safer, and greener solution to bus riders.Today, Shuttl serves over 1,00,000 rides daily in seven cities including Delhi-NCR region, Mumbai, Kolkata, Pune, Chennai & Hyderabad. It covers 350+ long routes and operates a fleet of 2000 buses. It has also been awarded UK’s Ashden Award (2018) and Road Safety Award by FICCI (2017). Shuttl is backed by Sequoia Capital, Amazon Alexa Fund, Times Internet, Lightspeed Ventures, Dentsu Ventures, Toyota Tsusho & SPARX Group.

Zenergize Power Tech Private Limited is an indigenous Indian manufacturer of Silicon Carbide (SiC) solar inverters and EV charging equipment, designed from the ground up for India’s heat, grid instability, and regulatory requirements. Our solar inverters use Infineon SiC technology - operating at 97–98% efficiency and maintaining full output at 55°C, where conventional IGBT inverters lose 10–15% capacity. All inverters are BIS IS 16221 certified, making them fully eligible for PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidies. Product range: grid-tied solar inverters (5kW, 8kW, 15kW), residential and commercial AC EV chargers (3.3–22kW), and DC fast chargers (30–240kW). All products connect to ZenSense - our proprietary solar + EV monitoring app. Founded by IIT engineers. Manufactured in Parwanoo, Himachal Pradesh. PAN-India installation and service across 40+ cities.

One of the most diversified integrated steel producers with a capacity of 36 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) across India, the Netherlands, the UK, and Thailand, Tata Steel is shaping a better tomorrow through innovation, sustainability, and an enduring commitment to excellence. The Company’s Jamshedpur, Kalinganagar and IJmuiden plants have been recognised among the World Economic Forum Advanced 4th Industrial Revolution (4IR) Global Lighthouses. With over 77,000 employees across the globe, Tata Steel is a Great Place to Work®-certified organisation. The Company recorded a consolidated turnover of approximately US$26 billion in the financial year ending March 31, 2026.Tata Steel has set an ambitious target of achieving Net Zero emissions by 2045. The newly inaugurated 0.75 MTPA electric arc furnace-based steelmaking facility in Ludhiana is the Company’s first low-emission plant in India. In the UK, Tata Steel is transitioning to a 3.2 MTPA EAF-based steelmaking route while in the Netherlands, the Company has signed a non-binding Joint Letter of Intent with the Government of the Netherlands and the Province of North-Holland on integrated decarbonisation and health measures project.Focused on sustainability, innovation, agility, and fostering deep relationships with customers and communities, Tata Steel aspires to become the most respected and valuable metals and mining company globally.

basic_profile.name: Puja Bardhan
basic_profile.headline: Product @Delhivery | IIM Bangalore
basic_profile.summary:
I'm a product leader with 9 years of experience building enterprise-grade solutions and scaling tech products from the ground up. Currently at Delhivery, I lead the TransportOne product—a B2B SaaS Transport Management System—where I've taken it from concept to market, onboarded marquee clients, and continue to scale adoption through differentiated procurement and execution workflows. I also own the P&L for our cross-docking solution for TransportOne clients, enabling direct fulfillment from client's regional warehouses, reducing costs by eliminating unnecessary handling and hops.

Before product, I spent time in management consulting at PwC, where I drove supply chain transformations, procurement efficiencies, and go-to-market strategies across sectors. I also co-founded a 30-minute hyperlocal medicine delivery startup, which, while short-lived, gave me a crash course in execution, grit, and user empathy.

I'm driven by a strong bias for action, product intuition grounded in systems thinking, and a deep interest in solving real-world logistics and marketplace problems. Outside work, I enjoy mentoring young PMs, exploring behavioral economics, and tinkering with product ideas that make everyday systems smarter and simpler.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 413,000 associates worldwide (as of December 31, 2025). The company generated sales of 91 billion euros in 2025. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With its business activities, the company aims to use technology to help shape universal trends such as automation, electrification, digitalization, connectivity, and an orientation to sustainability. In this context, Bosch’s broad diversification across regions and industries strengthens its innovativeness and robustness. Bosch uses its proven expertise in sensor technology, software, and services to offer customers cross-domain solutions from a single source. It also applies its expertise in connectivity and artificial intelligence in order to develop and manufacture user-friendly, sustainable products. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources. The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 500 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development. past.employer_linkedin_description: Maharatna ONGC is the largest producer of crude oil and natural gas in India, contributing around 70 per cent of Indian domestic production. The crude oil is the raw material used by downstream companies like IOC, BPCL, HPCL to produce petroleum products like Petrol, Diesel, Kerosene, Naphtha, Cooking Gas-LPG.ONGC is India’s Top Energy Company and ranks 14th among global energy majors (Platts). It is the only Indian company to figure in Fortune’s ‘Most Admired Energy Companies’ list. ONGC ranks 226th overall in Forbes Global 2000. Acclaimed for its Corporate Governance practices, Transparency International has ranked ONGC 26th among the biggest publicly traded global giants. It is most valued public enterprise in India, and one of the highest profit-making and dividend-paying.ONGC has a unique distinction of being a company with in-house service capabilities in all areas of Exploration and Production of oil & gas and related oil-field services. Winner of the Best Employer award, a dedicated team of over 25,000 professionals toil round the clock in challenging locations.ONGC is an integrated energy company with interests in upstream, midstream and downstream sector of the hydrocarbon value chain, renewables, LNG, Power generation, petrochemicals and Value Added Products. ONGC's wholly-owned subsidiary Navratna ONGC Videsh Limited (OVL) is the biggest Indian multinational in the energy space, participating in 32 oil and gas properties in 15 countries. ONGC's subsidiary Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (MRPL) is a Schedule ‘A’ Miniratna, with a single-location refining capacity of 15 million tons per annum. ONGC subsidiary HPCL is a Maharatna CPSE, and has the second largest share of product pipelines in India with a pipeline network of more than 3370 kms for transportation of petroleum products and a vast marketing network consisting of 14 Zonal offices and 133 Regional Offices.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Shadowfax is building the infrastructure behind India's fast-moving commerce economy.For over 11 years, we have enabled businesses to move faster, reach further, and serve customers better. Today, leading brands including Nykaa, Myntra, AJIO, Meesho, Mokobara, and Dot & Key rely on Shadowfax to power deliveries across the country.As consumer expectations continue to evolve, speed has become a defining force in commerce. Shadowfax enables businesses to meet those expectations through a technology-driven logistics platform built on scale, reliability, and operational excellence.From same-day and next-day delivery to 30-minute hyperlocal fulfilment, express parcel, reverse logistics, and supply chain solutions, we support the full spectrum of modern commerce. Through technology, intelligent automation, sustainable mobility, and relentless execution, we are building the future of commerce movement in India.Because commerce moves at Shadowfax speed.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the space agency of the Government of India headquartered in the city of Bengaluru. Our vision is to "harness space technology for national development", while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration. ISRO is managed by the Department of Space (DoS) of the Government of India.Indian Space Research Organisation, formed in 1969, superseded the erstwhile INCOSPAR. ISRO is one of the six largest space agencies in the world. ISRO maintains one of the largest fleet of communication satellites (INSAT) and remote sensing (IRS) satellites, that cater to the ever growing demand for fast and reliable communication and earth observation respectively. ISRO develops and delivers application specific satellite products and tools to the Nation: broadcasts, communications, weather forecasts, disaster management tools, Geographic Information Systems, cartography, navigation, telemedicine, dedicated distance education satellites being some of them. The PSLV was developed as a cost efficient and reliable launch system which went on to become a favoured carrier for satellites of various countries due to its reliability and cost efficiency, promoting unprecedented international collaboration. The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) was developed keeping in mind the heavier and more demanding Geosynchronous communication satellites.Future readiness is the key to maintaining an edge in technology and ISRO endeavours to optimise and enhance its technologies as the needs and ambitions of the country evolve. Thus, ISRO is moving forward with the development of heavy lift launchers, human spaceflight projects, reusable launch vehicles, semi-cryogenic engines, single and two stage to orbit (SSTO and TSTO) vehicles, development and use of composite materials for space applications etc.

The Indian Institute of Management Calcutta (IIMC) was established as the first national institute for Post-Graduate studies and Research in Management by the Government of India in November 1961 in collaboration with Alfred P. Sloan School of Management (MIT), the Government of West Bengal, The Ford Foundation and Indian industry. During its initial years, several prominent faculty formed part of its nucleus, including Paul Samuelson, Jagdish Sheth, J. K. Sengupta, among others.Today, the institute serves as an autonomous body, continually evolving to meet its goals in an ever-changing business environment.The vision of the Institute is to emerge as an International Centre of Excellence in all facets of Management Education, rooted in Indian ethos and societal values. Over the past four decades, IIM Calcutta has blossomed into one of Asia's finest Business Schools. Its strong ties to the business community make it an effective mechanism for the promotion of professional management practices in Indian organizations. Today, IIM Calcutta attracts the best talent in India - a melting pot of academia, industry and research. The best and brightest young men and women pursue its academic programs.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Imagine transforming a space the size of Eden Gardens, into full-fledged co-living residences within one month. Or personalizing over 2 lakh meals a day for tens of thousands of choosey students. Well, at Stanza Living, we don’t merely imagine these. We have built these capabilities. With our industry-first full-stack technology ecosystem. An ecosystem that’s taken us from a bootstrapped startup to India's largest managed-accommodation provider for students and young working professionals. In just 3 years. Along the way, giants of the venture capitalist world - Equity International, Falcon Edge Capital, Sequoia India, Matrix, Accel Partners and Alteria Capital to name a few - have put their confidence in us. Or to be specific, in the tech innovations we’ve introduced to a traditional industry. Like a digital process that allows us to onboard 3X as many residents as everyone else in the business. Like machine-learning algorithms that predict the kind of activity our residents would love at their next community event. Like an A.I.-powered security infrastructure that keeps an eye out for suspicious activity on our premises. Like all the out-of-the-box ideas you could bring to the table too, if you were part of our team at Stanza Living. Ideas that could redefine the way India lives, by redefining what tech can achieve. Just imagine.

You probably know Cars24 for buying and selling cars. Fair. But that’s a surprisingly small part of what we do now. We’re an AI-native automotive ecosystem operating across India, Australia and the UAE, and somewhere along the way we’ve built, bought and backed a bunch of things you may already use without knowing they’re Cars24: Team-BHP, CarInfo, VehicleInfo, Cars24 Financial Services, Loans24, Insure24 Cars24 Labs and Crashfree India. Today, we are in commerce, credit, insurance, vehicle intelligence, content, community and road safety, basically wherever owning a car still feels harder, slower or stupider than it should. It’s a slightly unreasonable amount of stuff around one thing we really care about: Better Drives, Better Lives.Always moving FORWARD.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID), is a 'Maharatna' Company operating under Ministry of Power, is engaged in power transmission business. POWERGRID is a listed Company, with 57.90% holding of Government of India and balance by Institutional Investors & public. Power Grid Corporation of India limited (POWERGRID) was incorporated on October 23, 1989. POWERGRID started functioning on management basis with effect from August, 1991 and it took over transmission assets from NTPC, NHPC, NEEPCO and other Central/Joint Sector Organizations during 1992-93 in a phased manner. POWERGRID has been implementing various transmission projects for generation capacity addition under central sector, Ultra Mega Power Projects (UMPPs), Independent Power Producers (IPPs) and other projects. With rapid increase in asset base of the organisation, National Transmission Asset Management Centre (NTAMC) has been established, which is manned by experts on 24x7 basis to provide expert handling to system & equipment.

The Indian School of Business (ISB) evolved from the need for a world-class business school in Asia. Established in 2001, the ISB has successfully put India on the global map of management education by pioneering several new trends in research, promoting innovation and training and nurturing young leaders who not only have an understanding of the developing economies but the society at large. With two state-of-the-art campuses in Hyderabad and Mohali, ISB provides opportunities to engage with the best of global management practice and thinking. In 2008, ISB became the youngest institution to be ranked among the Top 20 Global B-schools by the Financial Times, London, and since then has been ranked consistently among the top B-schools globally. A proficient pool of research-oriented resident and visiting faculty from top management institutions worldwide provides the essential thrust to ISB’s research milieu. ISB’s strong research acumen has helped produce knowledge and competencies to benefit industry and society, not only in India but across Asia and the rest of the world. Around the world, the School is represented by its network of 17,200+ alumni from the PGP and AMP suites, PGP,PGPMAX, PGPpro, PGP MFAB, AMPBA, AMPH, AMPI, AMPOS, and AMPPP, and the 50,000+ alumni of its Executive Education programmes.Whether it is through innovations in curricula to reflect the shifting business landscape or stimulating experiences and learning outside the classroom, the ISB is committed to providing the best avenue for management education and research to meet the growing need to develop young leaders who can manage global challenges.For more information on the School, visit www.isb.edu Follow us:Twitter: www.twitter.com/ISbeduFacebook: https://www.facebook.com/ISBedu/YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/isbindiaInstagram: https://www.instagram.com/isbindia/Blog: https://blogs.isb.edu/

basic_profile.summary:
I’m a P&L and Growth Leader with 8+ years of experience scaling tech-enabled consumer and logistics businesses across India. My work spans multi-city marketplace expansion, intercity logistics, product-led operations, and revenue/margin ownership—delivering measurable business impact across Spinny, Rivigo, Shell, and ITC.

Across these roles, I’ve led transformations that include:

Scaling a consumer marketplace to ₹400 Cr+ ARR with 100% growth in 4 months

Driving $30M+ global OPEX savings and $50M working capital optimization

Expanding national logistics networks by 300+ fleet units

Delivering ₹21 Cr+ annual savings through industry-first operational innovation

Owning multi-city P&Ls and optimizing unit economics, pricing, and margins

I operate at the intersection of Product × Operations × GTM, partnering with cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, launch new city models, strengthen unit economics, and identify high-value customer segments (relocation, gifting, premium services, etc.). My leadership style centers on speed, clarity, and data-driven decision-making—turning ambiguity into scalable systems.

What energizes me most is taking businesses from 0→1 and 1→10. I enjoy building high-performance teams, designing ground-up operational frameworks, running rapid growth experiments, and unlocking new market opportunities. Whether in consumer services, logistics, or supply chain environments, I bring a founder-mindset backed by structured execution, commercial depth, and operational excellence.

Always open to conversations around:
P&L leadership • Marketplace & logistics scaling • Intercity growth • Product-led operations • GTM strategy • Unit economics • Strategic partnerships • CX improvement • High-growth execution

If you’re building something challenging and high-velocity, I’d love to connect.

It includes professional shows, competitions, amateur rock bands, Ustads and Pandits, fashion shows, Indian folk dances, and other events. Antaragni has included performances by Shankar–Ehsaan–Loy, Poets of the Fall, Sunidhi Chauhan and Raghu Dixit. The festival also aims to serve as a platform for the expression of youth opinion on social problems. It began as an inter-collegiate cultural event in 1966, and now draws in over 30,000 visitors from 300 colleges in India. Antaragni is a non-profit organisation run completely by students of IIT Kanpur. It started off small, funded entirely by the Student Gymkhana of IIT Kanpur. Today the budget is over ₹1 crore (₹10 million), raised through sponsorship.

basic_profile.summary:
12 years of intensive experience in Product conceptualization and Tech development in different domains - Logistics, Healthcare, ecommerce, Telecom, IOT, Saas. I have worked both in early stage startups and enterprise companies. I have expertise in building high performance distributed systems using Agile Principles with strong focus on security and cost optimization.

In 2008, ISB became the youngest institution to be ranked among the Top 20 Global B-schools by the Financial Times, London, and since then has been ranked consistently among the top B-schools globally. A proficient pool of research-oriented resident and visiting faculty from top management institutions worldwide provides the essential thrust to ISB’s research milieu. ISB’s strong research acumen has helped produce knowledge and competencies to benefit industry and society, not only in India but across Asia and the rest of the world. past.employee_description:
Led global mid-mile operations for over 100 oil and by-product consignments, facilitating $2B in trade across 40+ geographies. My role combined high-stakes execution with strategic planning, crisis response, and stakeholder coordination in fast-paced, cross-border environments.

Key Achievements:
	•	Selected (1 of 300) to lead a 15-member external team during a critical five-year maintenance project in Turkey—completed ahead of schedule, saving $150K.
	•	Increased cargo intake by 250 tons (~$100K in revenue) by optimizing loading throughput based on performance curve analysis.
	•	Averted $15M in losses by developing and executing an emergency recovery strategy during a critical navigation incident in Argentina.
	•	Improved port turnaround time by 12%, reducing annual port charges by $200K through bottleneck identification and cross-training of crew.
	•	Accelerated post-merger integration (Synergy acquisition of Maersk) by 60% through SOP redesign and implementation across functions.
	•	Achieved zero deficiencies in international compliance audits, saving $90K in penalties.
	•	Led containment of a major oil spill, mitigating $2.5M in environmental penalties through quick team mobilization and execution.
	•	Reduced emergency response time by 27% by introducing weekly KPI monitoring and updated emergency protocols.
	•	Liaised with global regulatory authorities to streamline 50+ compliance checks and reduced customs clearance time by 30%.
	•	Safeguarded 23 lives and avoided $5M in losses during a piracy threat, and led emergency actions to prevent a potential capsize (impact: $50M avoided).

past.employee_description:
As part of the mid-mile segment of the global supply chain, I was handpicked (4 out of 102 officers) by senior management to lead high-stakes operations for 20+ chemical consignments worth over $500M. My role focused on driving process excellence, cost optimization, and risk mitigation in high-pressure, compliance-heavy environments.

Key Achievements:
	•	Achieved a 10% reduction in procurement costs (~$60K annually) through vendor consolidation and contract renegotiations.
	•	Reduced logistics costs by 9% by optimizing maintenance schedules and batching deliveries.
	•	Lowered F&B costs by 13% by building a demand forecasting model and implementing inventory controls, reducing stockouts by 22%.
	•	Designed a supplier performance dashboard and quarterly evaluation system to identify underperforming vendors.
	•	Revamped fleetwide risk assessment protocols (20+ ships) by factoring in vessel-specific constraints—resulting in improved safety outcomes.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Gopali Youth Welfare Society (GYWS) is a non-government organization (NGO) run by a team of students and professors of IIT Kharagpur, with assistance from local social enthusiasts. Established in 2002 and registered under the West Bengal Societies Registration Act in 2004, GYWS aims to improve the living standards of the people of Gopali (a village located 5 km from the IIT campus), and tackling social, economic and educational problems faced by the rural communities through its projects and initiatives.One of GYWS's prime projects is Jagriti Vidya Mandir, an English-medium school in Gopali, which aims to provide education to children from underprivileged backgrounds. Established in 2008, the school currently has students studying from Nursery to Class V. Started initially in a leased building, the school has since moved to its own permanent campus, which is planned to be developed into a hostel-cum-school campus with classes up to XII. To financially support our students’ education, GYWS started the 'Educate A Child' scheme under which interested donors can adopt and fund a child’s education, including costs for books, stationery, uniform, transport etc. for an entire academic year. A number of alumni, students and professors of IIT Kharagpur are a part of this initiative. GYWS also has a number of other initiatives in the fields of prevention of child labour, women empowerment, grievance redressal for government activities, health awareness etc.The Society and its activities are mainly supported by donations from alumni,  professors and students of IIT Kharagpur, as well as local industries. All donations to GYWS are exempted from taxes under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act and Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA).Like us on Facebook - http://www.facebook.com/gyws.iitkgp/

Leading large-scale gateway and logistics operations for Delhivery’s Pune network, with a focus on operations strategy, network performance, capacity planning and process transformation.

• Managed performance across high-volume operations handling and peak processing.

• Drove structured RCA and operational interventions across 40+ network metrics spanning service levels, critical ageing, connection adherence, capacity, productivity and last-mile performance.

• Improved key operational controls, contributing to reduction in mix-bag failures and liquidation of LPMA cases through focused process governance.

• Led manpower and productivity optimisation initiatives, rationalising deployment of mandays while building further reduction roadmaps through roster redesign and workforce reallocation.

• Built client-, lane- and shift-level failure analytics to identify systemic bottlenecks across high-volume network operations and design targeted interventions around vehicle capacity, connection prioritisation and processing windows.

• Driving gateway capacity planning, facility transition and network redesign initiatives in collaboration with Network Design, Engineering, Infrastructure, Linehaul, Last Mile, Customer Service and HR teams.

My role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—using data, structured problem-solving and cross-functional leadership to build scalable, reliable and cost-efficient logistics operations.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Army is the largest branch of the Indian Armed Forces and is responsible for land-based military operations. Its primary mission is the National Security and Defense of India from external aggression and threats, and maintaining peace and security within its borders. It also conducts humanitarian rescue operations during natural calamities and other disturbances. The Indian Army is one of the three services under the Ministry of Defence.The President of India is the Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Armed Forces, and thus of the Indian Army. past.employer_name: Sical Logistics Ltd., Cafe Coffee Day Company
past.employer_linkedin_description: Sical Logistics Ltd., founded in 1955 and with revenues in excess of Rs. 800 Cr., is India’s leading integrated logistics solutions provider with over 5 decades of experience in providing end to end logistics solutions. In 2011 Sical was acquired by the Rs. 4000 Cr. Coffee Day group, one of India’s fastest growing business conglomerates with interests ranging from coffee plantations and agri-businesses, commodity exports, stakeholdings in leading IT and embedded technology companies, real estate and hospitality.While traditionally known for its stevedoring, customs handling, trucking and steamer agency businesses, Sical today has made significant investments in logistics related infrastructure and operates mechanized Port terminals (container and bulk), container freight stations, container rakes, rail and road terminals. The success mantra is based on creating right process, investing in right infrastructure, recruiting and nourishing capability of employees, constant training and exemplary business ethics.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Feedback Infra is India’s leading infrastructure services company with interests across sectors like transportation, energy and urban infrastructure. It provides consulting, engineering, project management, operations and EPC services for new and existing projects. Feedback Group carries out its business through its subsidiaries. Feedback Highways OMT offers end-to-end service for toll roads and ETC Cards including major maintenance and catch-up works. Feedback Power O&M is engaged in providing operations and maintenance services to power plants across India, Africa and Indonesia. Another subsidiary, Feedback Energy Distribution Company Ltd (FEDCO), provides electricity distribution services as a Distribution Franchisee in the states of Meghalaya and Tripura. It also offers EPC services in Transmission and Distribution from power infrastructure development to household electrification under DDUGJY and Saubhagya scheme.Feedback Infra is privately held with ADV Partners, IDFC First Bank and HDFC Limited as its shareholders, besides the Promoter Group. Headquartered in Gurugram, it employs over 6,000 employees, and has five regional offices and 98 project offices. Besides having a strong presence across the length and breadth of the country, it has footprints in 35 countries across Africa, Middle-East and Asia. Government Authorities, Lenders, Concessionaires, PE Funds, Multilateral Institutions and Contractors are its leading customers. The Company also advises several State Governments regarding PPP transactions and assists several national governments across Africa. Its Architecture practice has been servicing Dubai markets for several years and has recently setup an office in India. An Integrated Suite of ServicesWe undertake Asset Creation, Operations and Maintenance and Infrastructure Delivery services across each of these verticals.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Prione (a JV between Catamaran and Amazon) was established in 2014 with the vision to enable small and medium businesses (SMBs) in India’s fast-growing digital economy, by creation and upliftment of SMB capabilities. Since then, we have expanded our presence to 150+ cities, grown to employ 600+ people and enabled 100,000 SMBs to sell online and 3.5 Million+ SMBs to accept digital payments. The company’s journey evolved from setting-up Feet on Street teams along with photo studios (for digital cataloging) in ~30 cities to help SMBs start online initially in 2014 to now having capabilities across a wide array of complex e-commerce products and services like online advertising, logistics services and digital payment solutions to help SMBs scale and grow their online business in 150+ cities.

It’s an exciting journey to constantly dabble with ideas that transform bus travel for millions; the 8 million happy customers we’ve served so far and many more to come. We’re proud to be a part of go-MMT group (NASDAQ: MMYT). redBus has morphed into an Indian multinational with footprint in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, Cambodia, Colombia, Peru, and expanding into other geographies.Millions of customers, over 70,000 routes, association with over 3000 reputed bus operators – our ecosystem offers a level of complexity and opportunity that the brightest minds will thrive on. Delhivery is India’s only end-to-end e-commerce enablement business with a vision to create outstanding consumer experiences by enabling sellers and consumers to connect faster.

Today, Delhivery provides an array of products and services for online businesses - including online channel integration services, sourcing, catalogue management, inventory management, multi-city fulfillment, express shipping, same day delivery services, reverse logistics, offline payment collection and processing, customer support, social media engagement and channel analytics.

We work with e-retailers, merchants and offline retailers across the country.
Our operational capabilities are designed to meet the needs of any business looking to go online. We provide sellers a modular suite of e-commerce technologies coupled with pan-India logistics operations, helping them achieve fast, reliable and flexible customer fulfillment.

Our proprietary commerce technologies toolkit provides sellers a way to develop and manage their entire online channel - including setting up a web-store and order management system, catalogue management, studio services, integration with marketplaces, managing payments, SEO/SEM, selling on social media platforms, user verification and fraud detection, inventory management. All our IT is built in-house and is completely customized to the unique needs of each of our clients

past.employer_linkedin_description: ICICI Lombard is the leading private general insurance company in the country. The Company offers a comprehensive and well-diversified range of products through multiple distribution channels, including motor, health, crop, fire, personal accident, marine, engineering, and liability insurance. With a legacy of over 2 decades, ICICI Lombard is committed to customer centricity with its brand philosophy of ‘Nibhaye Vaade’. The company has issued over 39.2 million policies, over 3.4 million claims processed and has a Gross Written Premium (GWP) of ₹ 306.18 billion for the year ended March 31, 2026. ICICI Lombard has 341 branches and 15,008 employees, as on March 31, 2026. ICICI Lombard has been a pioneer in the industry, being the first large-scale insurance company in India to migrate its entire core systems to the cloud.  With a strong focus on being digitally-led and agile, the company has introduced multiple AI-powered insurance solutions. The company’s flagship insurance and wellness app, IL TakeCare, which has received over 21.0 million downloads, also offers the industry’s first Face Scan feature. The company has won several prestigious awards- including the Insurance Asia, ICC Emerging Asia Insurance, ET BFSI Exceller, ET Corporate Excellence, Golden Peacock, FICCI Insurance, Assocham, Stevie Asia Pacific, and National CSR in recognition of its various initiatives. For more details log on to https://www.icicilombard.com/

I have successfully identified and addressed key gaps in policy implementation and quality control, streamlining standard operating procedures (SOPs) to drive improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Navy is a well-balanced and cohesive three-dimensional force, capable of operating above, on and under the surface of the oceans, efficiently safeguarding our national interests.The Indian Navy is the naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Navy. The Chief of Naval Staff, a four-star admiral, commands the navy.The Indian Navy traces its origins back to the East India Company's Marine which was founded in 1612 to protect British merchant shipping in the region. In 1793, the East India Company established its rule over eastern part of the Indian subcontinent i.e. Bengal, but it was not until 1830 that the colonial navy was titled as His Majesty's Indian Navy. When India became a republic in 1950, the Royal Indian Navy as it had been named since 1934 was renamed to Indian Navy.The primary objective of the navy is to safeguard the nation's maritime borders, and in conjunction with other Armed Forces of the union, act to deter or defeat any threats or aggression against the territory, people or maritime interests of India, both in war and peace. Through joint exercises, goodwill visits and humanitarian missions, including disaster relief, Indian Navy promotes bilateral relations between nations.As of July 2017, Indian Navy has 67,228 personnel in service and has a fleet of 137 warships and 235 aircraft.[4][5][6] As of March 2018, the operational fleet consists of one aircraft carrier, one amphibious transport dock, eight landing ship tanks, eleven destroyers, thirteen frigates, one nuclear-powered attack submarine, one ballistic missile submarine, fourteen conventionally-powered attack submarines, twenty-two corvettes, one mine countermeasure vessel, four fleet tankers and various other auxiliary vessels.The Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) exercises operational and administrative control of the Indian Navy from the Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence (Navy).

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Navy is a well-balanced and cohesive three-dimensional force, capable of operating above, on and under the surface of the oceans, efficiently safeguarding our national interests.The Indian Navy is the naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Navy. The Chief of Naval Staff, a four-star admiral, commands the navy.The Indian Navy traces its origins back to the East India Company's Marine which was founded in 1612 to protect British merchant shipping in the region. In 1793, the East India Company established its rule over eastern part of the Indian subcontinent i.e. Bengal, but it was not until 1830 that the colonial navy was titled as His Majesty's Indian Navy. When India became a republic in 1950, the Royal Indian Navy as it had been named since 1934 was renamed to Indian Navy.The primary objective of the navy is to safeguard the nation's maritime borders, and in conjunction with other Armed Forces of the union, act to deter or defeat any threats or aggression against the territory, people or maritime interests of India, both in war and peace. Through joint exercises, goodwill visits and humanitarian missions, including disaster relief, Indian Navy promotes bilateral relations between nations.As of July 2017, Indian Navy has 67,228 personnel in service and has a fleet of 137 warships and 235 aircraft.[4][5][6] As of March 2018, the operational fleet consists of one aircraft carrier, one amphibious transport dock, eight landing ship tanks, eleven destroyers, thirteen frigates, one nuclear-powered attack submarine, one ballistic missile submarine, fourteen conventionally-powered attack submarines, twenty-two corvettes, one mine countermeasure vessel, four fleet tankers and various other auxiliary vessels.The Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) exercises operational and administrative control of the Indian Navy from the Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence (Navy).

basic_profile.name: Lt Col Anirban  Das
basic_profile.headline: Senior Director – Risk Analysis, Loss Prevention & Business Continuity | Large-Scale Logistics Networks | 23+ Years Army & Corporate Operations | Delhivery
basic_profile.summary:
I work at the intersection of supply chain operations, network risk, and operational resilience in large logistics systems.

An Indian Army veteran with over two decades of experience across military logistics and commercial supply chains, I have operated in environments where operational continuity, discipline, and resource optimisation directly influence mission or business outcomes.

Currently, I serve as Senior Director at Delhivery, where I lead risk analysis, loss prevention, and business continuity across critical mid-mile infrastructure supporting high-volume logistics networks.

My work focuses on identifying vulnerabilities within complex operational systems — from process deviations and fraud risks to systemic inefficiencies that quietly translate into operational and financial loss. By strengthening governance, analytics, and control frameworks, I work to improve resilience while sustaining the speed and scale demanded by modern logistics networks.

Across both military and corporate roles, my experience sits at the intersection of operations, risk management, and organisational resilience in large distributed systems.

I occasionally share reflections on supply chain risk, operational resilience, and system design in large logistics networks.

Always open to thoughtful conversations on supply chain operations, risk, and operational resilience.
📩 AnirbanDas.org@outlook.com

As one of India’s top multiplex chains, INOX operates 730 screens in 171 multiplexes across 74 cities of India. The entertainment venture of the renowned INOX Group, started its journey in 2002 from its 1st multiplex in Bund Gardens Pune, now entertains 70 Mn guests across the country annually. In the process, INOX has set high benchmarks of ‘Luxury’, ‘Service’ & ‘Technology’ in the cinema exhibition industry.Thriving on innovativeness, INOX has pioneered plenty of ‘firsts’ in the industry. INOX operates Megaplex at the Inorbit Mall Malad, Mumbai, a multiplex with highest number of cinema viewing experiences in the world, which is also home to India’s first ScreenX as well as India’s first screen with MX4D® Theater Effects. INOX was the 1st cinema chain in the country to operate a Laserplex, a multiplex with all the screens enabled with Laser Projection. With the grand & immersive IMAX screens already a part of its repertoire, INOX also has to its credit, Mumbai’s first Samsung ONYX LED screen at the Megaplex. INOX’s 7-star cinema viewing experience, INSIGNIA, has emerged as top luxury proposition in the country. INOX’s desire to offer tailor-made experiences to its patrons led to the creation of home-grown formats like the vibrant and lively KIDDLES for the young audience, the smart luxury experience CLUB for the discerning guests and BIGPIX a premium giant screen cinema format. INOX’s focus on developing captivating architectural designs make the multiplexes look aspirational and also complete the ‘Experience’ promise. Driven by its passion to improvise unremittingly and deliver moments which may be treasured by patrons, INOX is committed towards operating a sustainable, responsible and profitable business venture and attain new levels of operational brilliance.

Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Parachute Regiment (Special Forces) was the brain child of Lt Col Megh Singh who created the "Meghdoot Force" in 1965. This was later merged with "The Parachute Regiment" in 1966 to form the first Commando Battalion  called the 9 Para Commando Battalion and then in 1967, 10 Para Commando Battalion. This was the first time ever Commando Battalion were raised and then in 2001 all Commando Battalions were         re-desginated as Special Forces Battalion due to change in the mandate. Today the Parachute Regiment (Special Forces) is the punch line of the Indian Armed Forces along with other specialised units from the Indian Navy (Marine Commandos) and Indian Air Force (Garuds). The Parachute Regiment Special Forces also contribute to many other specialised units like National Security Guards and Special Group. This is a closed group is dedicated to all those brave souls who have laid down their life for the man standing next to him, his country and to all those who have served in Para (Special Forces) of The Parachute Regiment.

Two chartered accountancy firms S.P. Puri & Co. and S.C. Vasudeva & Co., well-known in the profession, especially in North India have merged to form SCV & Co. LLP with effect from 1st April 2018 which has now been converted into a Limited Liability Partnership.Mr. Puri and Mr. Vasudeva, both qualified as Chartered Accountants in early 1960s. Mr. Puri and Mr. Vasudeva both being contemporaries reorganised and expanded their respective practices in the year 1976 with the same set of core values i.e. Integrity, Quality, Client Care and Trust. While S.P. Puri & Co, specialised in taxation and allied services, S.C. Vasudeva & Co. carved a niche for itself in the field of audit and allied services. Both the firms had humble beginning and have grown over the years in terms of service offerings and client base. The coming together of the firms is with an eye for the future, bringing tremendous synergies in operations and provides a platform to move ahead in this industry.The primary service offerings of SCV & Co. LLP are Assurance, Risk Advisory, Tax Advisory, Corporate Advisory and Outsourcing. Our comprehensive connections with various firms and chartered accountants globally enables us to provide our clients with a unique combination of extensive global resources, world‐recognized expertise and deep local knowledge. We remain committed to the ongoing growth of this global capability in all areas of services.VISION:Shall be a leader in providing high quality services in the field of Audit and Assurance, Accounting, Tax and Business Advisory to domestic and international clients. The firm would have offices in principal cities of India and would develop niche areas for the future growth of the firm.MISSION:To deliver services in a timely manner. To create value for our clients. To maintain our personal relationships with the clients that are the foundation of our practice. To provide an enjoyable learning experience and an opportunity for growth for all.

HT Media Group is among India's largest media and entertainment conglomerates. The Group's offerings spanning Print, Audio, and Digital verticals, have remained crucial and relevant for nearly a century in influencing culture and shaping public opinion. The Group enjoys wide-reaching popularity and has built reliable credibility across its Print brands - English daily Hindustan Times, the Hindi daily Hindustan, and the business publication Mint. It enjoys a prominent presence in the Audio space through much-loved and enjoyed brand offerings, including Fever FM, Radio Nasha, Radio One, FAB Market, HT Smartcast, and Punjabi Fever. The Group has continued to build on the success of its online recruitment and skills training portal Shine.com, with a positive foray to further its Digital offerings through the Mosaic Digital product umbrella that operates news and research platforms VCCircle, TechCircle, and EdgeInsights focused on serving the investment and enterprise technology communities. The Group also owns popular Internet businesses, including OTT Play, Slurrp, and Healthshots. For more details, visit www.htmedia.in.

past.employer_name: Techkriti, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur
past.employer_linkedin_description: Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur, established in 1959, is one of the premier institutions established by the Government of India. The aim of the Institute is to nurture young minds and drive forward leadership in technological innovation. Techkriti is the annual international Technical & Entrepreneurship festival of IIT Kanpur organised by the students of IIT Kanpur to realise this aim.Since its founding in 1995, Techkriti has developed into one of Asia's biggest technology festivals. Annually, the event spans four days in March and draws attendees from all across India and overseas, with over 40,000 people attending from both countries.Apart from fierce and neck to neck competitions in various fields, such as Robotics, Electronics, Business, Design, Coding, Aero-modelling, Online events (Crypto, Stocksim etc.). We also have guest lectures and exhibitions to inspire the students to take that extra step towards innovation.Late Dr. A. P.J. Abdul Kalam, the former president of India and the man behind the country's missile program; Dr. Hamid Karzai, the former honourable president of Afghanistan; Vladimir Voevodsky, the Russian field medalist; Douglas Osheroff, the Nobel Laureate in Physics; Michael Foreman, the NASA astronaut; Marshall Strabala, the architect of Burj Khalifa; Prof. Henry Schaffer III, the winner of the Peter Debye Award in the United States;Walter Lewin, the astrophysicist at MIT; Rakesh Sharma, the Indian astronaut; Alvin E. Roth, the Nobel Laureate in Economics; and many more have graced the students and academic community in the past. With its 31st edition, Techkriti is poised to stimulate innovation and eradicate social problems through social campaigns in this century of technocrats and entrepreneurs.For a more detailed description, visit https://techkriti.org or log on tohttps://www.instagram.com/techkriti.iitk/https://www.facebook.com/techkriti.iitkhttps://www.youtube.com/@TechkritiIITKanpurhttps://x.com/techkriti_iitk
past.employee_description: Planned and Organized two International Robotics Competition in which about 500 participants from 7 countries participated, during 14-17th March 2013. 3 other robotics events were also organised

past.employer_linkedin_description: Make A Difference (MAD) is one of India's largest millennial-driven, non-profit organizations working to transform outcomes for children in need of care and protection.MAD's Vision is that all children that grow up in care in India are able to realize equitable outcomes on par with the middle class.MAD’s Mission is to ensure that all children in shelters across India are able to realize equitable outcomes within the next 25 years, by mobilizing the community, empowering the child, enabling the sector, and changing the ecosystem. We are building new holistic, integrated, and long-term developmental methodologies that enable us to work with children in an age-transitional way, all the way from young childhood into adulthood, from age 10 to 28.As of today Make a Difference works with approximately 3500 children in partnership with 60 shelters across 23 cities in India, through a highly efficient and unique operating model that is almost entirely volunteer-driven with an overall workforce size of 4000 in flat, distributed structure that runs on virtual infrastructure. We operate at less than 1/10th the cost of an equivalent sized non-profit, with no loss in continuity, retention or quality, and are pioneers in both culture and organisational design that is specialized for impact. Make A Difference consistently ranks in the Top 10 Best NGOs to Work For in India, and most recently ranked in India's Top 10 Great Mid-size Workplaces across all sectors in the Great Place To Work Institute's 2018 Survey.

Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. past.employer_linkedin_description: Tata 1mg is India’s #1 digital health platform. Launched in 2015 (originally as 1mg), the platform is  trusted by millions of Indians for making healthcare accessible, understandable, and affordable.  With over 200 million unique visitors annually, it ranks among the world’s largest healthcare content platforms. It also serves around 6 million people annually for their healthcare transaction needs. Tata 1mg offers integrated healthcare services including ePharmacy, Diagnostics and eConsultations, delivered via a digital platform, institutional partners as well as with a growing network of retail stores across India. It is a clear market leader across its key business segments and one of the fastest growing D2C Consumer branded supplements players in India. Tata 1mg also has one of the largest structured databases of healthcare data in the country and is one of India’s leading players in the use of AI models in healthcare in India.Tata 1mg leverages its omnichannel network to deliver medicines pan-India in over 20K pincodes. With a focus on innovation and accessibility, Tata 1mg is redefining healthcare in India, ensuring that quality care is always within reach, wherever you are.

Established in 1964, BHEL is one of India's largest engineering and manufacturing enterprises in the energy and infrastructure sectors, and a leading power equipment manufacturer globally. BHEL serves the core sectors of the economy and provides a comprehensive portfolio of products, systems and services to customers in power, transmission, transportation, renewables, water, defence & aerospace, oil & gas, and industry. BHEL has created value for its stakeholders due to the scale and depth of its operations, rich experience, competent manpower, innovative ecosystem, diverse product-mix and focus on sustainable business solutions. BHEL’s greatest asset- its highly skilled and committed workforce of more than 34,000 employees is the cornerstone of its success.BHEL’s commitment to nation building reflects in many ways- in its contribution to the country’s installed power generation capacity; bringing the latest state-of-the-art technology to the country; consistent highest expenditure of more than 2.5% of its turnover on R&D and innovation in the Indian engineering segment; pan-India presence; establishment of world-class assets with presence in over 84 country across the globe, and contribution to the society at large through initiatives in skilling youth, health & hygiene, education, cleanliness and environment protection, to name a few.With a widespread network of 16 manufacturing facilities, 2 repair units, 4 regional offices, 8 service centres, 1 subsidiary, 3 active joint ventures, 15 regional marketing centres, 3 overseas offices and current project execution at more than 150 project sites across India and abroad, BHEL manufactures a wide range of high quality & reliable products adhering to national & international standards. BHEL has installed over 1000 utility sets worldwide with its installed base of supplied power generating equipment exceeding 185 GW. BHEL has also commissioned 200+ electric substations & 5 major HVDC projects in the country.

Ola is India’s largest mobility platform and one of the world’s largest ride-hailing companies, serving 250+ cities across India. The Ola app offers mobility solutions by connecting customers to drivers and a wide range of vehicles across bikes, auto-rickshaws, metered taxis, and cabs, enabling convenience and transparency for hundreds of millions of consumers and over 1.5 million driver-partners.Ola’s core mobility offering in India is supplemented by its electric-vehicle arm, Ola Electric; India’s largest fleet management business, Ola Fleet Technologies and Ola Skilling, that aims to enable millions of livelihood opportunities for India's youth. With its acquisition of Ridlr, India’s leading public transportation app and investment in Vogo, a dockless scooter sharing solution, Ola is looking to build mobility for the next billion Indians. Ola also extends its consumer offerings like micro-insurance and credit led payments through Ola Financial Services and a range of owned food brands through India’s largest network of kitchens under its Food business. Ola was founded in 2010 by Bhavish Aggarwal and Ankit Bhati with a mission to build mobility for a billion people. For more details, visit www.olacabs.com/media

basic_profile.name: Gourav Kumar Pandey
basic_profile.headline: Senior Director OPS
basic_profile.summary: As a senior operations leader with over 10 years of experience in e-commerce and logistics, I have built and led large-scale supply chain operations across Amazon, Blinkit, and Delhivery. My expertise spans fulfillment center operations, hub operations, last-mile logistics, network optimization, operational excellence, and organizational leadership.Throughout my career, I have successfully scaled complex, high-volume operations by combining strategic planning with disciplined execution. I have led cross-functional teams, driven operational transformation, and consistently delivered improvements in productivity, cost efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.Currently, I serve as Senior Director – Hub Operations (Uttar Pradesh) at Delhivery, where I lead one of the company's largest regional hub networks. I oversee operations across 10+ hubs, managing a daily throughput of 400,000+ shipments while leading a workforce of 1,500+ off-roll associates and 40+ on-roll leaders (Managers and above). My responsibilities include network performance, capacity planning, cost optimization, operational strategy, stakeholder management, and leadership development to ensure scalable and sustainable business growth.Previously, I spent 8 years at Amazon, leading fulfillment center and last-mile operations, where I developed deep expertise in Lean operations, process excellence, and customer-centric execution. I also served as Fulfillment Center Operations Head at Blinkit, driving warehouse performance and operational scalability in the fast-paced quick-commerce ecosystem.My leadership philosophy is centered on building high-performing teams, developing future leaders, and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. I enjoy solving complex operational challenges, leveraging data to drive strategic decisions, and delivering measurable business outcomes that create long-term value.I am always open to connecting with leaders and organizations that are shaping the future of supply chain, logistics, and operations through innovation, technology, and operational excellence.

With 14 years of experience in various aspects of operations, I am currently the Director of Operations - GW at Delhivery, India's leading logistics and supply chain services company. My role involves overseeing the ground operations, quality, and performance of the fulfillment centers, warehouses, and transportation hubs across the State.

I am passionate about innovation, excellence, and teamwork, and I strive to create a culture of continuous improvement and learning in my organization.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (ABFRL), part of the Aditya Birla Group, is India’s leading fashion powerhouse, offering a distinguished portfolio of renowned brands and retail formats, catering to multiple high-growth segments. As of Mar 31, 2026, the Company has presence across 1,273 stores spanning over 7.9 Mn sq.ft. retail space.ABFRL’s portfolio includes Pantaloons, one of India’s most loved fashion destinations, and OWND a growing retail format for GenZ and the youth. The Company also operates The Collective, who commands a dominant position as one of the country’s most influential multi-brand luxury retailers, with exclusive long-term tie-ups with global fashion brands including Ralph Lauren, Ted Baker and Fred Perry. ABFRL has also partnered with Paris based Galeries Lafayette to introduce a high-end luxury destination in India.ABFRL is a market leader in branded ethnic wear, its portfolio includes Jaypore and Tasva and it has forged strategic partnerships with India’s top designers such as Tarun Tahiliani, Sabyasachi, Shantnu & Nikhil and House of Masaba. Recently, the Company further expanded its ethnic wear leadership with the integration of TCNS brands, home to leading women’s brands W, Aurelia, Wishful, Elleven and Folksong.To address the evolving preferences of digitally native consumers, ABFRL is also building a portfolio of new-age, digital-first fashion brands under its tech-led venture TMRW. This platform collaborates with emerging entrepreneurs to co-create scalable fashion businesses in India’s rapidly expanding fashion ecosystem.

past.employee_description:
Led a 27-member team and revolutionized the logistics sector. We optimized nationwide tractor transportation via road and rail, significantly enhancing our supply chain efficiency and setting new industry standards.

I took vendor optimization to a whole new level, forging game-changing relationships and executing precision strategies to elevate our dispatch capacity. This proactive approach not only supercharged our logistics performance but also kindled a profound sense of client satisfaction, solidifying our position as an industry leader.

Led the Shadow Board Project, transforming Auto/Car Carriers distribution. Optimized routes, raising gross margin from 18% to 27%. Implemented Oracle Transport Management for seamless tractor outbound transportation, overseeing a vast fleet.

Exceeded revenue targets at Nagpur Stockyard by 13%, saving INR 75 lakhs over two years. Reduced rework per hundred (RPH) in primary transportation to unmatched levels. During the lockdown, safely guided INR 50 crore inventory in 2 months, showcasing exceptional stakeholder management and seamless logistics operation.

My innovative spirit extended to pioneering projects in reverse logistics, unlocking annual savings of INR 2 Cr. Simultaneously, I launched fleet management initiatives that opened green channels, maximized vehicle utilization, and unleashed a torrent of innovative logistics solutions, ushering in substantial cost savings.

Executed a monumental reduction in rework per hundred (RPH) from a staggering 12.3% to a mere 0.34%. My strategic use of tools like Pareto, Fishbone, and PFD delivered results. I streamlined storage processes, slashing costs from INR 1.78 Cr to 1.31 Cr, while reducing loading turnaround time from 45 minutes to an astonishing 20 minutes.

My entrepreneurship secured Eicher Tractors' transportation business. I managed independent operations, directing dispatch via trains to Bangladesh. This strategy boosted revenue, margin and successful market expansion

past.employer_linkedin_description: 關於台驊集團迎向世界_運籌全球化物流事業台驊從一家只有6個人的小公司,一步步發展到全球超過1,500名員工的集團事業。30年來,台驊國際投資控股股份有限公司始終為客戶走在時代前端,領先同業進入中國市場、建立集團優勢,成為物流業界最具競爭力的潛力股。因為從小做起,我們比別人更用心,積極引進管理新知,不斷創新和發展;因為要贏得第一,我們比別人更積極主動,建構完整的物流網絡,提供客製化服務,與客戶共同成長。「立足台灣,深耕大中華,放眼全世界」,台驊控股不僅是台灣第一家以全方位物流業務為主的上櫃公司,更成為亞太地區首屈一指的物流產業控股公司,「多元市場」與「多元產品」的優勢,帶給您全方位物流配套服務,成為客戶行銷全球最忠實的物流夥伴。集團價值理念承載信賴 傳遞未來追求與客戶共同成長,共創美好未來,是台驊國際集團自創立以來始終不變的目標。我們的服務不僅要滿足客戶的物流需求,更要以最專業的服務品質、最完善的服務網絡,贏得客戶信賴。創新、誠信、整合服務,是我們成長的動力Technology創新身為國際性的物流集團,我們持續創新,帶領潮流,運用現代科技確保高效率的運作與全球運輸管理。長期以來,透過專業的IT團隊,因應客戶需求,提供量身訂製的電子商務服務,有效管理生產和節省存貨成本,增強市場競爭力。Trust誠信遍佈台灣、中國大陸、香港、美國、歐洲、東南亞及東北亞等地70多個營業據點,並結合全球近400家代理夥伴的支援與信賴,我們秉持專業、熱忱、迅速、確實的服務精神,用心、專注於每一個業務細節,提升客戶滿意度,達到顧客滿意與永續經營的雙贏局面。Total Solution整合服務在集團的平台下,透過各子公司產品線及人才的互補,提供客戶更完善的物流一條龍服務。從國際海空運貨物承攬、報關、倉儲、運輸配送到電子商務物流等領域,以最專業、最高效的服務內容與品質,滿足客戶全球布局全方位的物流服務需求。領先佈局、全方位發展,是我們運營的優勢品牌優勢:台商品牌,兼具國際化和在地化跨越兩岸三地平台的優勢。通路優勢:亞洲區完整據點之佈局,全球各地完善代理網絡。產品優勢:海、陸、空、內河及鐵運輸業務、倉儲物流及全方位之供應鏈管理物流服務。團隊優勢:專業、創新、熱忱的專業團隊。資訊優勢:先進ERP系統、倉儲運輸管理系統、供應鏈管理系統、電子商務管理系統,提供客製化資訊管理服務。綜合物流總覽综合型物流服务配套包括國際貨運、內貿倉儲、運輸、供應鏈管理、跨境電子商務物流、供應鏈金融台驊集團以海、空運進出口承攬服務為核心業務,不斷追求成長,延伸服務觸角,集結報關代理、內陸運輸、倉儲服務等全方位物流的綜合性物流集團。身為國際性物流集團,台驊控股深知資訊化管理的重要性,因此透過培養優秀的程式設計人員,致力於資訊系統的技術開發。現階段正逐步整合所有作業系統,並進一步升級電腦網路設備,期使能透過強大的資訊管理處理系統,更有效管理作業流程,並針對不同的客戶需求提供量身訂製的電子商務服務,有效管理生產和節省存貨成本,增強市場競爭力,取得行銷先機。我們提供的服務範圍:1.國際貨運2.內貿物流3.第三方物流服務4.供應鏈管理5.跨境電子商務物流6.供應鏈金融

past.employer_linkedin_description: One of the most diversified integrated steel producers with a capacity of 36 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) across India, the Netherlands, the UK, and Thailand, Tata Steel is shaping a better tomorrow through innovation, sustainability, and an enduring commitment to excellence. The Company’s Jamshedpur, Kalinganagar and IJmuiden plants have been recognised among the World Economic Forum Advanced 4th Industrial Revolution (4IR) Global Lighthouses. With over 77,000 employees across the globe, Tata Steel is a Great Place to Work®-certified organisation. The Company recorded a consolidated turnover of approximately US$26 billion in the financial year ending March 31, 2026.Tata Steel has set an ambitious target of achieving Net Zero emissions by 2045. The newly inaugurated 0.75 MTPA electric arc furnace-based steelmaking facility in Ludhiana is the Company’s first low-emission plant in India. In the UK, Tata Steel is transitioning to a 3.2 MTPA EAF-based steelmaking route while in the Netherlands, the Company has signed a non-binding Joint Letter of Intent with the Government of the Netherlands and the Province of North-Holland on integrated decarbonisation and health measures project.Focused on sustainability, innovation, agility, and fostering deep relationships with customers and communities, Tata Steel aspires to become the most respected and valuable metals and mining company globally.

basic_profile.name: Dr Harish Sharma
basic_profile.headline: Vice President at Delhivery
basic_profile.summary:
In an experience of more than 27years, I have achieved success in building profitable organizations, delivering competitive edge for revenue growth in start-up, mature and turnaround environments, strengthening operational excellence, and setting up scalable infrastructure from scratch for sales, marketing and distribution channels. 

I have headed large-scale business operations, developed and launched pioneering products, improved brand value, achieved leadership position in market share, driven growth to generate annual turnover in excess of INR 4500 crore (USD 60+ million), and increased margins in highly competitive markets.

Colleagues and business partners acknowledge me as an inspirational leader, value creator and business strategist, adept at adjusting quickly to challenges, leveraging business opportunities, and dealing effectively with key stakeholders.

Highlights:

At Aircel, I developed and led high-performing teams of up to 1000 people, established efficient technical, operational and manpower capabilities, built new business and distribution networks from the ground up, and turned around operations from EBITDA loss of INR 400 crore to EBITDA profit of INR 100+ crore within 2 years. At present I am heading the Wireless Business for West Region Circle.
While with Vodafone, I doubled the top line in one year, achieved market leadership position, and increased the subscriber base by penetrating new markets.

Specialities: 

P&L Management | Business Planning | Business Development | Go-to-market | Brand & Product Portfolio Management | Channel Partner Management | Budget & Margin Management | Post-M&A Integration | Team Building

Zenergize Power Tech Private Limited is an indigenous Indian manufacturer of Silicon Carbide (SiC) solar inverters and EV charging equipment, designed from the ground up for India’s heat, grid instability, and regulatory requirements. Our solar inverters use Infineon SiC technology - operating at 97–98% efficiency and maintaining full output at 55°C, where conventional IGBT inverters lose 10–15% capacity. All inverters are BIS IS 16221 certified, making them fully eligible for PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidies. Product range: grid-tied solar inverters (5kW, 8kW, 15kW), residential and commercial AC EV chargers (3.3–22kW), and DC fast chargers (30–240kW). All products connect to ZenSense - our proprietary solar + EV monitoring app. Founded by IIT engineers. Manufactured in Parwanoo, Himachal Pradesh. basic_profile.summary:
I am a forward-thinking security and risk management leader with 30+ years of experience spanning law enforcement, corporate security, logistics, and technology-led risk prevention. Currently serving as Chief Security Officer at Delhivery, I design and oversee security, trust, and safety frameworks across India’s largest logistics network — covering 24 automated sort centers, 90+ fulfilment hubs, 2,500+ delivery centers, and 58,000+ employees.

Previously, as a Superintendent of Police in Pondicherry, I specialized in trafficking, narcotics enforcement, cybercrime, and community policing, achieving a 99% conviction rate and pioneering India’s early cybercrime investigations.

I’ve driven business continuity, fraud prevention, safety, and compliance strategies for Fortune 500s, airports, defense, banking, and e-commerce. My leadership philosophy is built on change management, operational excellence, and digital transformation — blending public service discipline with corporate agility.

Recognized with awards including the Golden Peacock Award, SECONA Shield for Security Project of the Year, and Assocham SME Excellence Award, I also hold patents and publications on e-governance, fraud detection, and women’s safety tech solutions.

Specialties: Corporate Security, Supply Chain Risk, Fraud Analytics, Business Continuity, Regulatory Compliance, Project Management, Independent Directorship

past.employee_title: Head - Logistics Compliance and Corporate Affairs
past.employee_description:
Led compliance and corporate affairs team for Amazon logistics. Spearheaded engagement with multiple state governments in India for business continuity situations due to the rapidly changing tax and entry tax laws. Product managed the Amazon technology solution to automate the compliance requirements for movement of shipment across states in India.

1. Heading the regulatory operations at a country level and ensuring 100% compliance towards laws with smooth movement across the borders of states. Appointed a team of ~10 consultants to manage all the line haul movement across all modes.

One of the founding members of the Amazon Logistics, India launch team handling multiple projects/roles across network design, product, operations, channel development, corporate affairs, procurement, new initiatives at national and zonal levels. In the last assignment at Amazon, I was heading the regional operations including channel development for alternate deliveries for north last mile operations. 

1. Led a diverse team, that manages an assorted network of forward and reverse mile operations. Network handled ~2L shipments per day with 70+ hubs and 3.5k manpower. It involved handling the entire P&L. 
2. Built a high-performance team that delivered consistently for three years (2015-2017), on exponentially increasing complexity of e-commerce deliveries. 
3. Scaled the variable delivery channel (like I Have Space, Service Partner etc.) to support 10X growth in delivery operations. Optimising cost by ~40% while maintaining service levels of the network. 
4. Channel Development of I Have Space stores from ~500 to 3500 stores in a span of 8 months leading to their contribution shooting to ~65% from 15%. 
5. Design of two futuristic products to scale delivery operations for year 2020 plan. Operating design for both models has been stress tested and one of the models is part of a worldwide product. Estimated saving of ~ $200 MM in India operations. 
6. Build a lean work force engagement model for capacity optimisation in the last mile for managing the peak volumes). Achieved 35% improvement in the capacity utilisation.
