basic_info.name: Allcargo Global
basic_info.description: For over three decades, Allcargo Global (formerly Allcargo Logistics) has been shaping how the world moves. What began with a single vision to simplify global trade has grown into a worldwide logistics powerhouse.As part of the Allcargo Group, and through our wholly owned subsidiary, ECU Worldwide, we connect businesses across 60 countries, offering reliable, neutral, and scalable logistics solutions.Our portfolio — anchored by our leadership as the world’s No. 1 LCL consolidator — includes Neutral FCL, Air Freight, multimodal transport, door-to-door delivery, and value-added services, enabling end-to-end solutions that keep global supply chains moving seamlessly.Powered by ECU360, our digital platform, we combine innovation with experience — making logistics faster, smarter, and easier to manage.Built on purpose, sustainability, and trust, Allcargo Global continues to move not just cargo, but the ambitions and growth of businesses worldwide.As one of Allcargo Group’s flagship companies, we create synergies to offer CFS-ICD under Allcargo Terminals Limited, as well as a nationwide footprint of strategically located logistics and industrial parks.Give your business the advantage of more than three decades of expertise, and count on our digital-first and customer-centric approach to bolster business growth and progress.Partner with us to experience a world of difference, backed by ingenuity, innovation, and strong commitment to Environmental, Social and Governance standards with an aim to be carbon neutral by 2040.

basic_profile.name: Hareram T S
basic_profile.headline: Regional CEO - ISC & SEA at Allcargo Logistics Limited (NVOCC div) \​ Author
basic_profile.summary:
As the Regional CEO – NVOCC for the Indian Subcontinent and SEA at Allcargo Logistics, I have the privilege of leading a key part of one of the world’s top LCL consolidators. With a strong global presence and an unwavering commitment to excellence, Allcargo plays a pivotal role in connecting businesses and markets across the world.

My journey with Allcargo began in 2000, when I stepped in as a young Marketing Executive full of drive and curiosity. Over the past 25 years, I’ve grown alongside the organization — taking on evolving responsibilities and helping shape the NVOCC division across a dynamic and diverse region that includes the Indian Subcontinent and Southeast Asia.
What’s always inspired me is the purpose behind the work we do. Logistics, to me, is more than just moving goods — it’s about building connections, enabling opportunity, and delivering trust across borders. It’s this human side of logistics that has fueled my passion throughout the years.
With a background in marketing, and logistics management, I remain focused on delivering value through innovation, customer-centricity, and strategic growth. And above all, I’m proud to lead a passionate team that’s helping move the world — one shipment at a time.

Best Regards,

basic_profile.current_title: Senior Vice President - AI and Data Science
basic_profile.summary: I build AI-powered businesses — not just AI systems.  With 22+ years across AI, consulting, and entrepreneurship, I've led end-to-end AI transformations that have generated measurable revenue growth and operational efficiency at scale — across logistics, financial services, e-commerce, and media. What I bring:  * AI strategy ownership with outcomes and accountability* Full-stack AI delivery: from use-case identification to production deployment* AI talent building — hiring, structuring, and scaling AI teams* Responsible AI and governance frameworks* Democratizing AI across business functions, not just tech teams

past.employer_linkedin_description: Friends SocietyFriends Society is a youth organization providing various social services in Vadodara, India. It draws its members mostly from Maharaja Sayajirao University and also from other colleges in the nearby areas. FS, as its members call it fondly, is run almost entirely by student volunteers.The idea behind Friends Society is quite simple. It is to provide a meaningful alternative to youth to spend their free time in a constructive manner – that is, by providing social services to people in the surrounding communities. They organize visits to the home for blind children or for physically disabled children; work with children in underprivileged communities through Sunday Club, Sunday School and Cheer-up programs; help poor women increase their earning potential by teaching them to sew and embroider, organize blood donation camps, and so on. In all, these volunteers conduct around a dozen such activities. Friends Society serves following four sections of society:Activities for Differently Abled Children and AdultsCheer Up ProgramSunday SchoolSunday ClubShauryaActivities for Fatehganj CommunityYouth ClubPublic Reading room and LibraryBalwadiSewing and Embroidery Classes and Income GenerationVocational Training for WomenActivities for PatientsBlood Donation ProgramActivities for School Children and YouthProgram for Future LeadersProgram for University YouthThus, a volunteer can choose participate and contribute to any of the above activities.Self-development for volunteers:While providing services for the identified needs of the beneficiary remains the focus, an equally important goal is the growth of FS members through participation in these activities and by assuming formal and informal leadership roles. Sonalika Tractors is India's No. 1 tractor export brand, serving farmers across the globe with customised tractors and farm equipment to meet their evolving farming needs. Celebrating 30 Years of ‘Jeetne Ka Dum’, the company stands proudly as the 3rd largest tractor manufacturer in India - the world's biggest tractor market and among the top 5 tractor manufacturers around the world. With a legacy of growth and success, Sonalika is proudly recognised among Fortune 500 India’s Largest Companies in 2024 & 2025, a testament to the brand’s vision, leadership and commitment to farmer growth. The company takes pride in recording its highest ever annual tractor sales of 1,80,504 units in FY'26 and crossing 1,00,000 YTD tractor sales in just 6 months (April–September 2026) - its fastest-ever journey to this milestone!Growing rapidly with its advanced tractors and farm implements, the company has earned the unwavering trust of 20 Lakhs farmers in 150+ countries. Sonalika's widest tractor portfolio in 20-120 HP range is manufactured in the World's No.1 vertically integrated tractor manufacturing plant at Hoshiarpur, Punjab which is powered by robots and automation to roll out highest quality tractors. The company also took a quantum leap in the tractor industry by revealing its entire tractor and service costs on its official website to ensure transparency and customer peace of mind.Sonalika's farmer-centric approach & vision has earned the brand several awards including 'Iconic Brand of the Year' award by 'The Economic Times' 3 years in a row (2017-2019), 'Most Trusted Brand' 2021 and 'Global Innovations Leadership Award' by Agriculture Today in 2018 & 2019. Also, the company's dedication to support the farmers has made it the only tractor brand to be a part of NITI Aayog for doubling the farmer's income.

Delex setup in July 2009 is a company is invested and promoted by NDR group, a leading Indian Business group, engaged in logistics infrastructure development. The group currently has its own CFS/ICDs at major ports in India, including Mumbai, Tuticorin and Chennai. The Group started with building its own warehouse complexes and has >6 million sq.ft of owned warehousing space besides a nationwide presence providing warehousing and inventory management services to large customer base from Telecom, Retail and FMCG sectors. Being present in the initial parts of the Supply Chain i.e., inbound infrastructure & management thru own ICD/CFS, followed by the second level infrastructure & services thru own warehouses and inventory management services, as a natural progression, the group had chosen to take a step towards forward integration of its supply chain infrastructure and services capabilities by promoting Delex. Delex has its own infrastructure, complete with a fully integrated IT solution to provide distribution and delivery services.

At Toll, we do more than just logistics - we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 29 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post — www.tollgroup.comWhat moves you?At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.

Agility is a multi-business operator and long-term investor in global and regional businesses. Its portfolio of diversified international assets includes the world’s largest aviation services company (Menzies Aviation); a global fuel logistics business (Tristar); a leading logistics parks developer and operator across the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia (Agility Logistics Parks); and other businesses in digital logistics, e-commerce logistics, remote-site services, and public-sector logistics. It holds minority stakes in DSV, the world’s third-largest freight forwarder; Reem Mall, a mega-mall in Abu Dhabi; commercial real estate and supply chain companies in the GCC, and emerging technology companies in e-commerce enablement, energy transition, digital supply chain, and more. Agility has a global footprint across six continents and 80+ countries, with a workforce of 68,000 employees. It is publicly listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX).

1.As Deputy General Manager – IT Infrastructure, I manage a $10M+ IT budget, delivering:

2.Enterprise cloud adoption and infrastructure modernization

3.Large-scale global migrations with zero business disruption

4.Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, availability, and security posture

5.High-performing, cross-regional engineering and operations teams

I am passionate about positioning technology as a board-level strategic enabler, building future-ready IT organizations, and mentoring leadership talent. I am actively exploring opportunities in leadership Roles, where I can drive enterprise-wide transformation at scale.

💬 Let’s connect if you are looking for a technology leader to modernize platforms, optimize cloud investments, and build resilient global IT foundations.

basic_profile.name: Vaishnav Shetty
basic_profile.headline: Deputy Managing Director, Allcargo Global
basic_profile.summary: Vaishnav Shetty is the Deputy Managing Director of Allcargo Global, the flagship international supply chain business of Allcargo Group. Allcargo Global, along with its subsidiary ECU Worldwide, is the world's largest LCL consolidator, with 200 of its own offices across 60 countries. He drives the company's business across North Asia – including China, Japan, Korea, and Taiwan – and oversees the acceleration of the group's e-commerce expansion in the United States. A strong advocate of industry‑wide digital transformation, he leads Allcargo Group’s innovation charter through a structured incubation and investment programme that collaborates with logistics startups, universities, and venture capital networks. Under his leadership, the digital function at Allcargo has delivered industry-first solutions in machine learning, automation, and data science — creating measurable impact on productivity, decision-making, and customer experience across businesses. Vaishnav has been instrumental in creating ECU360, the world’s first end‑to‑end LCL digital platform, which continues to set industry benchmarks for its user experience and adoption globally. Its success has been recognised by leading global consultant McKinsey & Company in a report on the transformation of ECU Worldwide. ECU360 continues to drive significant increases in efficiency, customer satisfaction, and profitability worldwide. With a background in Economics from Emory University, USA, Vaishnav gained diverse global exposure through roles and internships at OOCL in Singapore, Dacheng Law and Stanford Law, the Blackstone Group in London, and Ernst & Young (EY). This foundation has shaped his approach to combining technology, strategy, and operational excellence to build future-ready supply chain ecosystems. He plays an integral role in shaping key strategic initiatives that advance Allcargo Group’s long-term business goals and purpose, while strengthening its position as a global logistics leader. Vaishnav is the co-chair of the Logistics & Supply Chain Committee at the Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC).

past.employer_linkedin_description: The CMA CGM Group is a global player in sea, land, air and logistics solutions, true to its corporate Purpose, "We imagine better ways to serve a world in motion".Present in 184 countries, it employs 170,000 people, of which nearly 6,000 in Marseilles where its head office is located.The world's 3rd largest shipping company, CMA CGM serves 420 ports across 5 continents with a fleet of 700 vessels. In 2025, CMA CGM carried 24.2 million TEU (twenty-foot equivalent unit) containers. Its subsidiary CEVA Logistics, one of the world's top five players, operates 1,000 warehouses and handles 15 million shipments of ground and rail freight. CMA CGM AIR CARGO, the Group's air freight division, operates a fleet of 8 cargo aircraft.CMA Media, France's 3rd largest private media group, includes RMC-BFM and several national and regional press titles (La Tribune Dimanche, La Tribune, La Provence and Corse Matin).Committed to energy transition, the CMA CGM Group is aiming for Net Zero Carbon by 2050.The CMA CGM Foundation provides humanitarian aid in crisis situations, and is committed to education for all and equal opportunities throughout the world. To date, the CMA CGM Foundation has transported more than 120,000 tonnes of humanitarian aid to 110 countries and supported over 630 projects.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

•    Meeting clients and delivery of consignment from proposal right up to delivery.

•    Development of the Overseas Agent Network
•    Procurement & Pricing for Import Freight & Land side Services
•    Data Management – Oracle CRM Tool, E-Freight & other internal systems of the organization.
•    Coordinating with Operations / accounts & Documentation

•    Sector Head for Far East
•    Discrepancy Resolution of sector
•    Monitoring weekly consoles being sent by overseas office and writing to them for freehand shipments.
•	Assisting Team to handle shipment smoothly and monitoring Real Time Information flow to customer about shipment status.

•    Preparing MIS Reports for Self and Team Members for Management Usage.

basic_profile.name: Sandeep K.
basic_profile.headline: Strategic Leader in Digital Supply Chain & Logistics | 20+ Years in E-commerce, Express logistics, and Contract logistics |
basic_profile.summary:
"In the dynamic world of logistics, focusing on inputs and processes with a long-term vision ensures sustainable success." - Sandeep Kulkarni.

As the Chief Operating Officer at Allcargo Logistics, I have the privilege of driving strategic planning, operational efficiency, and innovative logistics solutions for one of India’s premier express distribution and supply chain solution providers. Leading a team of over 2,000 people and managing 600+ operations units, my focus is on optimizing our extensive logistics network, including sort centers, warehousing, and fulfillment centers, while overseeing the P&L for a significant revenue stream.

With over 20 years of diversified leadership experience in retail, e-commerce, logistics, and supply chain management, my journey has been marked by successful ventures from scaling startups to optimizing established operations. Previously, as the Chief Supply Chain Officer at Tata CLiQ, I restructured fulfillment networks, strengthened vendor relationships, and managed substantial budgets, ensuring better speed and customer experience. At Jio Mart, I spearheaded the end-to-end business for the West region, transforming the grocery landscape with innovative SC networks and sales policies.

During my tenure at Amazon, I led operations for Amazon Fresh, managing the farm-to-fork business, and scaled a low-cost fulfillment channel that handled a significant portion of Amazon's business in India. At Larsen and Toubro Infotech, I played a crucial role in formulating and implementing corporate strategies, working closely with senior leadership to drive substantial revenue growth. My career began with a distinguished tenure in the Indian Navy, where I held leadership roles in strategic planning, operational performance, and project management for submarine operations.

My expertise lies in leveraging new-age, data-driven technologies to enhance supply chain agility, responsiveness, and resilience. I am a strong advocate for infrastructure development, policy advocacy, and sustainable practices in the logistics industry.

Outside of work, I find joy and inspiration in long road-bike rides, playing golf, and exploring bookstores. I am fluent in English, Hindi, Marathi, and French (elementary proficiency).

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Navy is a well-balanced and cohesive three-dimensional force, capable of operating above, on and under the surface of the oceans, efficiently safeguarding our national interests.The Indian Navy is the naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Navy. The Chief of Naval Staff, a four-star admiral, commands the navy.The Indian Navy traces its origins back to the East India Company's Marine which was founded in 1612 to protect British merchant shipping in the region. In 1793, the East India Company established its rule over eastern part of the Indian subcontinent i.e. Bengal, but it was not until 1830 that the colonial navy was titled as His Majesty's Indian Navy. When India became a republic in 1950, the Royal Indian Navy as it had been named since 1934 was renamed to Indian Navy.The primary objective of the navy is to safeguard the nation's maritime borders, and in conjunction with other Armed Forces of the union, act to deter or defeat any threats or aggression against the territory, people or maritime interests of India, both in war and peace. Through joint exercises, goodwill visits and humanitarian missions, including disaster relief, Indian Navy promotes bilateral relations between nations.As of July 2017, Indian Navy has 67,228 personnel in service and has a fleet of 137 warships and 235 aircraft.[4][5][6] As of March 2018, the operational fleet consists of one aircraft carrier, one amphibious transport dock, eight landing ship tanks, eleven destroyers, thirteen frigates, one nuclear-powered attack submarine, one ballistic missile submarine, fourteen conventionally-powered attack submarines, twenty-two corvettes, one mine countermeasure vessel, four fleet tankers and various other auxiliary vessels.The Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) exercises operational and administrative control of the Indian Navy from the Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence (Navy).

basic_profile.name: Subash Babu
basic_profile.headline: Facility Head at Allcargo Terminals Ltd
basic_profile.summary:
Experienced competent and astute professional with 24 years’ of cross-functional experience in Terminal Operations, Container Freight station, ICD , Logistics , Transportation , Warehouse, Customs & shipping documentation, Legal & Claims, Concession Authorities & Customs coordination’s for setting up of new green field project.

Expertise in implementation of best Safety practices, HSE policies as laid out by both P&O Ports, as well as DP World, mitigating soft and hard controls.

Liaison with Kamarajar Port Authorities and Howie team for completing the Green field project at Ennore. The Project was completed and operations commenced as per the specified timelines, without any delays.

Liaison with Concor, Railways and Concession authority to bring first ICD rake in 2017 at Ennore Port.

Accomplished effective processes to deliver complex logistics functions between the Katupalli Port and CFS.
Expertise in finalizing the Contracts and setting up of new terminal. This also included recruitement of skilled manpower for Container Terminal operations.

Gained experience and expertise in smart analysis thereafter preparation of challenging Budgets with ways to overperform the same.

Expertise in negotiating with Unionized and contractual workforce for running the terminal operations without any interruptions.

Expertise in setting up from scratch, Operational procedures, Documentation procedures, Gate management, Yard management, Vessel management, Equipment control and team building.
Infusion of technology to improve processes through RFID systems at Kattupalli Port & CFS, as well as at Ennore Port.

Worked with Adani Analytics team to implement Dashboards for Mundra, Kattupalli & Ennore to view operational performance.

Expertise in Customer focus and needs, as required by CRM.

Competent in handling external contacts with Terminal users for the smooth functioning of the Terminal
Gained rich experience and contacts with Shipping line Customers, as well as Auto logistics.

Good contacts with trade bodies, government departments and stake holders.

Ability to lead and motivate Business team to capture greater market share and gain Customer confidence.

basic_profile.name: Hareram T S
basic_profile.headline: Regional CEO - ISC & SEA at Allcargo Logistics Limited (NVOCC div) \​ Author
basic_profile.summary:
As the Regional CEO – NVOCC for the Indian Subcontinent and SEA at Allcargo Logistics, I have the privilege of leading a key part of one of the world’s top LCL consolidators. With a strong global presence and an unwavering commitment to excellence, Allcargo plays a pivotal role in connecting businesses and markets across the world.

My journey with Allcargo began in 2000, when I stepped in as a young Marketing Executive full of drive and curiosity. Over the past 25 years, I’ve grown alongside the organization — taking on evolving responsibilities and helping shape the NVOCC division across a dynamic and diverse region that includes the Indian Subcontinent and Southeast Asia.
What’s always inspired me is the purpose behind the work we do. Logistics, to me, is more than just moving goods — it’s about building connections, enabling opportunity, and delivering trust across borders. It’s this human side of logistics that has fueled my passion throughout the years.
With a background in marketing, and logistics management, I remain focused on delivering value through innovation, customer-centricity, and strategic growth. And above all, I’m proud to lead a passionate team that’s helping move the world — one shipment at a time.

Best Regards,

Since it’s inception in 1991, AGIL Freight Pvt. Ltd. is a registered multimodal transport operator with competitive process and cost effective solutions. With excellent experience, world class centrally integrated system and an ample network of partners we strive to provide the best to our clientele. Our team with sound experience to handle any type of technological issues puts their best foot forward and acts proactively to serve the ever-changing demands of the market.AGIL Freight Pvt. Ltd. incorporated in 1991 is a family owned but professionally managed business house. Its promoters originally dealt with shipping agency business as early as 1951. Handling breaks bulk & tramp vessels and Container Liner Principals till 1992 when we ventured into a new horizon of Freight Forwarding and logistics services. Though AGIL started as a domestic transport service provider, later on AGIL Freight Pvt. Ltd. went on to develop into a full fledged international multimodal transport operator with offices across India and now also in the Arabian Gulf.AGIL Freight Pvt. Ltd. offers outstanding services in Ocean and Airfreight, overland Transportation, Customs Broking, multimodal Transportation, Project Cargo Services, live Shows and Event Logistics.

basic_profile.name: Sandeep K.
basic_profile.headline: Strategic Leader in Digital Supply Chain & Logistics | 20+ Years in E-commerce, Express logistics, and Contract logistics |
basic_profile.summary:
"In the dynamic world of logistics, focusing on inputs and processes with a long-term vision ensures sustainable success." - Sandeep Kulkarni.

As the Chief Operating Officer at Allcargo Logistics, I have the privilege of driving strategic planning, operational efficiency, and innovative logistics solutions for one of India’s premier express distribution and supply chain solution providers. Leading a team of over 2,000 people and managing 600+ operations units, my focus is on optimizing our extensive logistics network, including sort centers, warehousing, and fulfillment centers, while overseeing the P&L for a significant revenue stream.

With over 20 years of diversified leadership experience in retail, e-commerce, logistics, and supply chain management, my journey has been marked by successful ventures from scaling startups to optimizing established operations. Previously, as the Chief Supply Chain Officer at Tata CLiQ, I restructured fulfillment networks, strengthened vendor relationships, and managed substantial budgets, ensuring better speed and customer experience. At Jio Mart, I spearheaded the end-to-end business for the West region, transforming the grocery landscape with innovative SC networks and sales policies.

During my tenure at Amazon, I led operations for Amazon Fresh, managing the farm-to-fork business, and scaled a low-cost fulfillment channel that handled a significant portion of Amazon's business in India. At Larsen and Toubro Infotech, I played a crucial role in formulating and implementing corporate strategies, working closely with senior leadership to drive substantial revenue growth. My career began with a distinguished tenure in the Indian Navy, where I held leadership roles in strategic planning, operational performance, and project management for submarine operations.

My expertise lies in leveraging new-age, data-driven technologies to enhance supply chain agility, responsiveness, and resilience. I am a strong advocate for infrastructure development, policy advocacy, and sustainable practices in the logistics industry.

Outside of work, I find joy and inspiration in long road-bike rides, playing golf, and exploring bookstores. I am fluent in English, Hindi, Marathi, and French (elementary proficiency).

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Navy is a well-balanced and cohesive three-dimensional force, capable of operating above, on and under the surface of the oceans, efficiently safeguarding our national interests.The Indian Navy is the naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces. The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Navy. The Chief of Naval Staff, a four-star admiral, commands the navy.The Indian Navy traces its origins back to the East India Company's Marine which was founded in 1612 to protect British merchant shipping in the region. In 1793, the East India Company established its rule over eastern part of the Indian subcontinent i.e. Bengal, but it was not until 1830 that the colonial navy was titled as His Majesty's Indian Navy. When India became a republic in 1950, the Royal Indian Navy as it had been named since 1934 was renamed to Indian Navy.The primary objective of the navy is to safeguard the nation's maritime borders, and in conjunction with other Armed Forces of the union, act to deter or defeat any threats or aggression against the territory, people or maritime interests of India, both in war and peace. Through joint exercises, goodwill visits and humanitarian missions, including disaster relief, Indian Navy promotes bilateral relations between nations.As of July 2017, Indian Navy has 67,228 personnel in service and has a fleet of 137 warships and 235 aircraft.[4][5][6] As of March 2018, the operational fleet consists of one aircraft carrier, one amphibious transport dock, eight landing ship tanks, eleven destroyers, thirteen frigates, one nuclear-powered attack submarine, one ballistic missile submarine, fourteen conventionally-powered attack submarines, twenty-two corvettes, one mine countermeasure vessel, four fleet tankers and various other auxiliary vessels.The Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) exercises operational and administrative control of the Indian Navy from the Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence (Navy).

basic_profile.name: Balfour Manuel
basic_profile.headline: Managing Director at Blue Dart
basic_profile.summary:
As Managing Director, I lead Blue Dart, South Asia's premier express air and integrated transportation & distribution company and part of Deutsche Post DHL Group’s DHL eCommerce Solutions division. 

Prior to my current role, I was Chief Executive Officer of the Company and also Senior Vice President in charge of Blue Dart’s B2B customers. 

I have also held a key senior management position at Blue Dart where I was responsible for the growth and development of the company’s business in the Western region in India.
 
I continue to drive the business with a clear strategic vision and focus on building a insanely customer centric culture at Blue Dart and sustaining our position as a Employer, Provider and Investment of Choice and fulfilling our Living Responsibility credo. 

I took over as Managing Director in 2019.

basic_profile.name: Beena Mathen Jacob
basic_profile.headline: Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)| DHL Group - Blue Dart Express | People Strategy · HR Transformation · 50,000+ Workforce | Logistics & Supply Chain HR | IIM Calcutta | Business World HR 50 under 50
basic_profile.summary: Leading 50,000+ people is not HR—it’s business strategy in action.As the CHRO of Blue Dart Express (DHL Group), I lead people strategy for 50,000+ employees and associates across South Asia's most awarded express logistics enterprise. I drive HR strategy aligned to our vision of excellence in express logistics. My mandate spans talent strategy, organisational development, DEI, culture transformation, HR technology, and workforce planning — supporting a business that moves millions of shipments every day across India.In logistics, HR isn't a support function — it's an operational enabler.With 25 years spanning HR, Sales and Operations — including 16 years in logistics — I have led HR at scale across three of the world's most recognized supply chain and express logistics organisations:▸ Blue Dart Express (DHL Group) — CHRO, 50,000+ workforce▸ DHL Supply Chain India — VP HR & CHRO, 19,000 employees▸ FedEx TSCS — Senior HR leadershipThis cross-functional foundation — spanning HR, Sales and Operations — is rare at CHRO level. It enables me to bridge people strategy directly with operational reality, speaking the language of both the boardroom and the frontline.Core expertise: Chief HR Officer | People Strategy | HR Transformation | Talent Management | Organisational Development | DEI & Inclusion | Culture Change | HR Business Partner | Workforce Planning | HR Analytics | Employee Experience | Frontline Workforce | Learning & Development | Employer Branding | Psychological Safety | AI in HR | Future of WorkMBA — Pune University | EPSHRM — IIM Calcutta | B.Sc Mathematics — Mumbai University

past.employer_linkedin_description: 123Greetings began in 1997 with a simple but powerful idea: to bring people closer through meaningful emotional expression... no matter the distance. Long before likes, stories, and instant messaging was a thing, we helped you pause and tell your friend, “I’m thinking of you” from the comfort of your home. A birthday card sent at midnight? A festival wish shared across time zones? An extraordinary note of encouragement on an otherwise ordinary day? We’ve helped our users do it all. OUR VISION: To live in a world where people never lose the habit of reaching out. Where care, celebration, and emotional presence remain essential, no matter how fast life moves or how often technology changes. OUR MISSION: Well, we wish to normalize thoughtfulness again... not as a grand gesture, but as a daily practice in day-to-day ordinary life. The world, as we know it, is starved for emotions. And we simply wish to keep it fed and full.

At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

basic_profile.name: Savio Mendonca
basic_profile.headline: Vice President- Internal Audit & Risk Management at Blue Dart Group
basic_profile.current_title: Vice President- Internal Audit & Risk Management
basic_profile.summary: Savio is a highly accomplished and experienced leader in the fields of Internal Audit and Finance. With a career spanning over three decades, Savio has gained extensive expertise across various sectors, including IT, Manufacturing, and Logistics. He has successfully led and managed the internal audit function for large listed corporations with complex global operations, demonstrating his ability to navigate and excel in challenging business environments.Savio's professional qualifications speak volumes about his commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. As a Chartered Accountant, Certified Information Systems Auditor, Certified Fraud Examiner and Certified Logistics Leader (CLL - DHL), Savio has acquired specialized knowledge and skills in accounting, information systems, fraud detection, finance management, and logistics. Currently serving as the Vice President of Internal Audit & Risk management at Blue Dart, Savio holds a key leadership role within the organization. In his prior positions, he held the position of Director at Capgemini, where he played an integral role in the Group Internal Audit. At IGATE Corporation, Savio served as the Head of Internal Audit - Corporate Risk Management, demonstrating his ability to identify and mitigate risks at an organizational level. He also served as the Head of Revenue Assurance at Patni Computers, where he showcased his expertise in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of revenue-related processes. Additionally, Savio contributed significantly to the Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) initiative and Costing Function at Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, further enhancing his proficiency in process optimization and financial analysis.Recognized as a subject matter expert, Savio frequently shares his knowledge and insights as a speaker at prominent professional forums such as the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) and the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Mumbai Chapter. His contributions to these platforms demonstrate his commitment to fostering professional development and knowledge-sharing within the industry.Savio's exceptional leadership and people management skills have earned him accolades and recognition. In 2021, he was ranked among India's Top 100 Great People Managers by the Great Manager Institute in association with Forbes India. This prestigious honor reflects Savio's ability to inspire and motivate his team members, creating a positive work environment that drives individual and collective success.

As of date, there are 54 Mobile 1000 Vans operating in 14 states and doing yeoman service to rural India.Its other programmes like Little Hearts, Swachhalaya, Bio Toilet, E-Learning, Khel Khel Mein, Wockhardt Health Education Institute, SHUDHU water purification tablets and Adarsh Gram Yojana have made significant impact and it continues to expand its social coverage in areas where the need is the most.Says it’s Trustee & CEO, Dr. HUZ (Dr. Huzaifa Khorakiwala) -"Wockhardt Foundation operates its social programmes based on the 3 B's - Big, Best and Bold. The Big ensures scale, the Best ensures quality and the Bold ensures need."Wockhardt Foundation is governed by a simple philosophy -"where every smilecounts".The work of Wockhardt Foundation has been well recognized in the outside world with it being the recipient of many Awards including the prestigious “Inclusive India Award - 2012” for the best social work in primary health by a corporate.

past.employer_linkedin_description: BCCL (The Times of India) is one of India's largest media company with iconic brands like The Times of India and Economic Times. The story of BCCL goes back to Nov. 3rd, 1838, when the flagship brand The Times of India, was published as a bi-weekly, The Bombay Times and Journal of Commerce. Since then, we have consistently moved up the growth curve by entering new markets & launching new titles. Today, we are a Powerhouse of successful Brands : We believe in shaping market trends with a portfolio of innovative brands. Our flagship brand, The Times of India, is the world’s largest circulating English daily & The Economic Times is the world’s second largest circulating English Business daily. We are driven by the indomitable spirit to question the conventional wisdom. Learning & Innovative : We are regarded as one of the most innovative publishing companies. Our unique 'Brand Capital model' is considered amongst the most innovative ideas. Previous innovations include Invitation Pricing, Combos, Space Drawing Rights & Advertorial Supplements. We provide our employees opportunities through world-class training programs. Great People : ‘Finest minds who inspire & drive innovative initiatives, build trust & encourage employees to achieve optimal performance’ is the Hallmark of our leadership team. We are one internally cohesive & disciplined team of people from diverse backgrounds. We invest in our people & our policies are designed for their long-term happiness. If you are curious & look for avenues of continuous improvement, this is the place to be!

basic_profile.name: Sandeep Petkar
basic_profile.headline: Vice President Regional Head - South, Bangalore |  Blue Dart, India | Profit Centre Head | F1 freak
basic_profile.current_title: Vice President Regional Head - South Region
basic_profile.summary:
An energetic leader with a passion to deliver results at all times with a vast experience and knowledge about express business. 

I started my career with Blue Dart in 1991 in its  IT function and continued to excel for  next twenty years before switching over to Sales Function in 2010. Held a position of Sales Head for next seven years at West2 region which is headquartered at Ahmedabad. It was 2017 when I was elevated to the position of Regional Head at West2 Region. On 1st September 2024, I moved to Bangalore to act as an Regional Head for Southern Region.

I am thoroughly enjoying  my current role as it allows me to connect with close to 3800 die-hard Blue Darters and lead them in offering their world class service to Blue Dart's esteemed customers.

To sum it up, I would like to state that it has been a wonderful and fun-filled journey of three decades which offered me huge opportunities to sharpen my skills, build a strong character and career and interact with huge number of internal and external customers, laced with numerous achievements and lots of learning.

basic_profile.name: Srividya Harish Venkateswaran
basic_profile.headline: HR Leader - Always thirsty for excellence, open to new ideas, and continuously learning—driven by a passion for well-being, human rights, and fostering growth with a side of humor!
basic_profile.current_title: Senior Director - Business HR and Talent Acquisition
basic_profile.summary:
At the forefront of Blue Dart's HR and talent acquisition, my expertise lies in aligning human resources operations with comprehensive global and regional strategies. The role involves strategic manpower planning, enhancing employee engagement, and fostering a robust culture of growth and continuous improvement. Our team's collaborative efforts with industry bodies and government authorities underscore our commitment to progressive talent development and succession planning.

With over 23 years of experience in leadership roles across HR, Service Delivery, and Business Operations, I have successfully led teams and driven strategic growth initiatives in major global organizations. Currently, as Senior Director - Business HR & Talent Acquisition at Blue Dart Express, I spearhead HR operations, talent acquisition strategies, and workforce planning, aligning them with organizational goals to ensure seamless business performance.

Throughout my career, I have held key roles in program management, service delivery, compliance, and risk management at organizations like DHL Global Forwarding, DXC Technology, HCL Technologies, IBM, and Thomson Reuters. I specialize in creating solutions that foster organizational growth, operational efficiency, and a positive workplace culture. My expertise spans governance, program delivery, financial advisory, regulatory compliance, employee engagement, and performance management.

basic_profile.summary: Enterprise logistics and supply chain leader with 20+ years of experience building, stabilizing, and scaling large-scale distribution ecosystems across express logistics, contract logistics, aviation cargo networks, and enterprise supply chain programs.   My work sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, enterprise client growth, logistics infrastructure, and operational execution, where regional markets, complex transportation networks, and enterprise clients operate as one synchronized system. I specialize in transforming fragmented logistics operations into integrated distribution platforms that deliver reliability, speed, and sustained commercial performance.    I have led geographically distributed logistics networks spanning air cargo operations, line-haul transportation, warehousing infrastructure, and last-mile delivery ecosystems, ensuring each layer of the network functions as part of a coordinated operational architecture. My leadership approach focuses on establishing operational clarity, reinforcing accountability frameworks, and enabling teams to operate with speed while maintaining service reliability.    At my core, I operate as a logistics ecosystem orchestrator, ensuring transportation networks, warehousing platforms, aviation cargo operations, and enterprise supply chain programs function as one integrated commercial system capable of delivering performance at scale.

The Indian Army is the largest branch of the Indian Armed Forces and is responsible for land-based military operations. Its primary mission is the National Security and Defense of India from external aggression and threats, and maintaining peace and security within its borders. It also conducts humanitarian rescue operations during natural calamities and other disturbances. The Indian Army is one of the three services under the Ministry of Defence.The President of India is the Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Armed Forces, and thus of the Indian Army. The highest ranking military officer is the Chief of Army Staff (COAS), who is also a member of the Chiefs of Staff Committee.The Indian Army came into being at the Independence of India in 1947, and inherited most of the regiments and infrastructure of the British Indian Army that were located in post-partition India.

basic_profile.summary: Leading 50,000+ people is not HR—it’s business strategy in action.As the CHRO of Blue Dart Express (DHL Group), I lead people strategy for 50,000+ employees and associates across South Asia's most awarded express logistics enterprise. I drive HR strategy aligned to our vision of excellence in express logistics. My mandate spans talent strategy, organisational development, DEI, culture transformation, HR technology, and workforce planning — supporting a business that moves millions of shipments every day across India.In logistics, HR isn't a support function — it's an operational enabler.With 25 years spanning HR, Sales and Operations — including 16 years in logistics — I have led HR at scale across three of the world's most recognized supply chain and express logistics organisations:▸ Blue Dart Express (DHL Group) — CHRO, 50,000+ workforce▸ DHL Supply Chain India — VP HR & CHRO, 19,000 employees▸ FedEx TSCS — Senior HR leadershipThis cross-functional foundation — spanning HR, Sales and Operations — is rare at CHRO level. It enables me to bridge people strategy directly with operational reality, speaking the language of both the boardroom and the frontline.Core expertise: Chief HR Officer | People Strategy | HR Transformation | Talent Management | Organisational Development | DEI & Inclusion | Culture Change | HR Business Partner | Workforce Planning | HR Analytics | Employee Experience | Frontline Workforce | Learning & Development | Employer Branding | Psychological Safety | AI in HR | Future of WorkMBA — Pune University | EPSHRM — IIM Calcutta | B.Sc Mathematics — Mumbai University

past.employer_linkedin_description: The journey of securing lives began in 1994 for Zicom. With years of expertise and experience, Zicom etched a name for itself in the field of Electronic Security Surveillance in India. Blue Dart’s Diversity and Inclusion initiatives have also led to it being recognized as one of India’s ‘Best Workplaces for Women’ in 2021 and ‘Best Organizations for Women’ in 2022 by the Economic Times.Blue Dart fulfils its social responsibility of climate protection (GoGreen), disaster management (GoHelp) and education (GoTeach) through its GoPrograms.

basic_info.name: Delhivery Robotics
basic_info.description: Delhivery Robotics’ modular VTOL UAV platform is engineered for real-world delivery logistics in complex environments. Designed for autonomy, reliability, and scale, this aircraft combines vertical takeoff and landing capabilities with long-range cruise performance to overcome infrastructure gaps in rural, semi-urban, and hard-to-reach regions.With a dedicated internal cargo bay sized for standard medium parcels, the platform enables fast, secure transport of critical goods—from commercial deliveries to emergency medical supplies. Its modular architecture supports swappable payload inserts, including temperature-controlled containers and integrated tracking systems.Whether supporting e-commerce in underserved areas or logistics in mission-critical conditions, this UAV system brings flexible, unmanned capability to the last mile and beyond.
industries: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

basic_info.name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd.
basic_info.profile_name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd.
basic_info.description: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (ABFRL), part of the Aditya Birla Group, is India’s leading fashion powerhouse, offering a distinguished portfolio of renowned brands and retail formats, catering to multiple high-growth segments. As of Mar 31, 2026, the Company has presence across 1,273 stores spanning over 7.9 Mn sq.ft. retail space.ABFRL’s portfolio includes Pantaloons, one of India’s most loved fashion destinations, and OWND a growing retail format for GenZ and the youth. The Company also operates The Collective, who commands a dominant position as one of the country’s most influential multi-brand luxury retailers, with exclusive long-term tie-ups with global fashion brands including Ralph Lauren, Ted Baker and Fred Perry. ABFRL has also partnered with Paris based Galeries Lafayette to introduce a high-end luxury destination in India.ABFRL is a market leader in branded ethnic wear, its portfolio includes Jaypore and Tasva and it has forged strategic partnerships with India’s top designers such as Tarun Tahiliani, Sabyasachi, Shantnu & Nikhil and House of Masaba. Recently, the Company further expanded its ethnic wear leadership with the integration of TCNS brands, home to leading women’s brands W, Aurelia, Wishful, Elleven and Folksong.To address the evolving preferences of digitally native consumers, ABFRL is also building a portfolio of new-age, digital-first fashion brands under its tech-led venture TMRW. This platform collaborates with emerging entrepreneurs to co-create scalable fashion businesses in India’s rapidly expanding fashion ecosystem.

basic_info.name: Bajaj Auto Ltd
basic_info.description: A journey that began 80 years ago in a corner of India and has since traversed the world. Uniting people from across countries, cultures, and customs over the years with a multitude of different dreams, there's power in an idea. An idea that gave rise to brands that stood the test of time, with partnerships it inspired, and the people who made it all happen. One idea that sparked a legacy - this is the story of Bajaj Auto. “Do what you think is best, but be the best in what you do.” - Kamalnayan BajajThese words embody the spirit of Bajaj Auto. From 1945 to today, from “Hamara Bajaj” to “The World’s Favourite Indian”- the most loved motorcycle brand in almost 80 countries, Bajaj Auto carries its rich legacy and unconventional thinking, with a penchant for staunch differentiation.This philosophy has helped us be No.1 or No.2 in over 20 countries with industry-leading EBITDA of ~20%. Some statistics that reflect our strength:•A Zero Debt 5.5 Billion Dollar Company•World’s largest three-wheeler and third-largest two-wheeler manufacturer•India’s Number 1 motorcycle exporter – 2 out of every 3 motorcycles exported are Bajaj•The largest exporter of Branded Goods – exporting over half of India’s two- and three-wheelers•Over 33% of revenue from International markets, with 15+ million motorcycles soldWith powerful brands, our spectrum ranges from Boxer in Africa to KTM in Europe, from Rouser in Latin America to Pulsar in India; our versatility is evident. International alliances with KTM, Husqvarna, and Triumph have ensured that our horizons are broadened.A pioneer in motorcycle technology, our R&D is world-class, with talent from all corners of the globe, with TPM being the prime mover of productivity for the last 25+ years. From lean manufacturing, we have now moved to lean engineering & lean marketing, which has led to globally competitive fixed costs.With ever-expanding plans to win over the world, the sun truly never sets on a Bajaj Motorcycle.

basic_info.name: IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation Ltd)
basic_info.description: IndiGo is India’s largest passenger airline. We operate with focus on our three pillars – offering low fares, being on-time and delivering a courteous and hassle-free experience. IndiGo has become synonymous with being on-time.Since our inception in August 2006, we have grown from a carrier with one plane to a fleet of 400+ aircraft today. A uniform fleet for each type of operation, high operational reliability and an award winning service make us one of the most reliable airlines in the world.IndiGo has a total destination count of 130+ destinations with 90+ domestic destinations and 40+ International destinations.
industries: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

basic_info.name: Jindal Steel Ltd.
basic_info.description: Jindal Steel is one of India’s foremost integrated steel producers, renowned for its scale, efficiency, and commitment to excellence. Operating on a robust mine-to-metal model, the Company leverages captive resources, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and a global distribution network to deliver high-performance steel solutions. With an investment footprint exceeding USD 12 billion, Jindal Steel runs state-of-the-art facilities in Angul, Raigarh, and Patratu, and maintains strategic operations across India and Africa. Its diversified and future-ready product portfolio underpins core sectors such as infrastructure, construction, and manufacturing, powering progress through strength and sustainability.Take the next step in your career with Jindal Steel by submitting your application to our Talent Acquisition team at "careers.hr@jindalsteel.in"

basic_info.name: MANKIND PHARMA LTD
basic_info.description: Mankind Pharma, one of the top 5 leading pharmaceutical companies in India, started its journey in 1995. Today, we have an employee base of over 20,000 and are racing towards $1 Billion. At Mankind, we aspire to aid the community in leading a healthy life by formulating, developing, commercializing, and delivering affordable and accessible medicines that satisfy urgent medical needs. We take great pride in the success of our products ranging from Pharma, OTC and FMCG brands like Manforce Condoms, Manforce Tablets, Manforce Staylong Gel, Unwanted 72, Prega News, Gas-O-Fast, Kaloree 1, Kabzend, Acne Star Gel and many others. Our operations are in 34 overseas destinations across Asia, Africa, South-East Asia, Gulf countries and CIS countries.Our Vision - To be a global pharmaceutical company, most admired for its Affordability, Quality and Accessibility of products.Our Mission - To be able to provide cost-effective, innovation based superior quality pharmaceutical products across the globe, to improve the lives of the patients.Mankind strongly believes and follows its Core Values:Customer Centricity: Commitment to Customer - Internal and ExternalQuality: It is in our DNA to maintain and deliver highest quality standards and productsInnovation: Intensely Research driven organization aiming at product innovation and technology improvementsIntegrity: Always trustworthy, widely respected to be honest, and believed by everyoneGo Beyond: Aim higher than capabilitiesPeople Development and Collaboration: Together we are foreseeing future and diligently stimulating our people in attaining goals

basic_info.name: McDermott International, Ltd
basic_info.description: McDermott is a premier provider of engineering and construction solutions to the energy industry. Our customers trust our technology-driven approach—engineered to responsibly harness and transform global energy resources into the products the world needs for now and what’s next.From concept to commissioning, we are creating and delivering the building blocks of the energy transition. Our innovative expertise and capabilities advance the next generation of global energy infrastructure—empowering a brighter, more sustainable future for us all. Operating in over 54 countries, our locally focused and globally integrated resources include more than 30,000 employees, a diversified fleet of specialty marine construction vessels and fabrication facilities around the world. To learn more, visit www.mcdermott.com.

basic_info.name: Alkem Laboratories Ltd.
basic_info.description: A single idea, which sprouts from a human mind, contains the potential to create marvels that can influence generations. It can redefine rules, it can transform the world. Back in the year 1973, a team of individuals came with such an idea – The idea called Alkem. It was highly potent and resilient, like a spark that could ignite a thousand more ideas. And it did!Looking back at our 4 decade, illustrious journey, that one small idea has Not only triggered us to become one of India’s largest generic and specialty pharmaceutical company but also, create a foothold in over50 countries32% of our revenue is generated via offshore sales. As well as we have consistently been ranked amongst the top ten pharmaceutical companies in India. Our portfolio includes illustrious brands like Clavam, Pan, Pan-D and Taxim-O, which feature amongst top 50 pharmaceutical brands in India. For over a decade, our dominance in anti-infective segment has remained unchallenged.We have 21 manufacturing facilities at multiple locations in India and the United States of America. Our upper-crest facilities are inspected and audited as per cGMP guidelines as laid down by leading regulatory authorities such as USFDA, MHRA - UK, SAHPRA-South Africa, TGA - Australia, ANVISA - Brazil, WHO - Geneva, TPD - Health Canada, PPB - Kenya, NDA - Uganda, MOH - Sudan, INVIMA - Colombia, TFDA - Tanzania, Zimbabwe, BfArM-Germany & Other Africa, Asian & CIS Countries.Another feather in our cap was added on December 23rd, 2015, when, Alkem completed it's Initial Public Offering (IPO) and was listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.Although passion is the fuel that keeps ideas alive, innovation is the catalyst that gives it flight! With over 500 scientists working in 5 global R&D centers, we are empowering innovations that align with our philosophy of ‘Extended Lifecare Beyond Boundaries’.

basic_info.name: Apollo Tyres Ltd
basic_info.description: Apollo Tyres Ltd, with its corporate headquarters in Gurgaon, India, is in the business of manufacture and sale of tyres since its inception in 1972. Over the years, the company has grown manifold, establishing its footprint across the globe.The company has manufacturing presence in Asia and Europe with 7 modern tyre facilities and exports to over 100 countries. Powered by its key brands — Apollo and Vredestein, the company offers a comprehensive product portfolio spread across passenger car, light truck, truck-bus, off highway and two-wheeler tyres, retreading material and retreaded tyres.

basic_info.name: Havells India Ltd
basic_info.description: Havells India Limited is a leading FMEG company with a strong global presence, manufacturing a wide range of electrical products for residential, commercial, and industrial use. Key brands include Havells, Havells Studio, Lloyd, Havells Crabtree, Standard Electricals and REO.With a focus on innovation and customer satisfaction, Havells boasts a robust distribution network, exclusive brand showrooms, and a strong emphasis on service. The company prioritizes sustainability, with a focus on renewable energy, waste reduction, and environmental conservation.Havells is committed to social responsibility, with initiatives in education, sanitation, and community development. Recognized for its sustainability efforts, Havells has been ranked in the Dow Jones Sustainability Index and maintains an 'A' rating in the MSCI ESG Rating.Learn more about Havells on the following channels: Facebook I Youtube I Twitter I Instagram I

basic_info.name: HCL Infosystems Ltd.
basic_info.description: HCL Infosystems Enterprise 360 offerings seamlessly combine the choice of multi-global brand IT & Technology Products and world-class IT services that span existing and emerging technologies. By enabling our clients across industries to attain and sustain competitive business edge we aim to be Your Technology Lifecycle Partner.

basic_info.name: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd
basic_info.description: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd. (MOFSL) was founded in 1987 as a small sub-broking unit, with just 2 people running the show.Focus on a customer-first attitude, ethical and transparent business practices, respect for professionalism, research-based value investing, and implementation of cutting-edge technology has enabled us to blossom into a 12,000+ member team.Today we are a well-diversified financial services firm offering a range of financial products and services such as Private Wealth, Retail Broking and Distribution, Institutional Broking, Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Commodity Broking, Currency Broking, and Home Finance.We have a diversified client base that includes retail customers (including High Net worth Individuals), mutual funds, foreign institutional investors, financial institutions, and corporate clients. We are headquartered in Mumbai and, as of September 2022, had a network spread over 550 cities and towns comprising 2500+ Business Locations operated by our Business Partners, us, and 5.2 Million+ customers.Research is the solid foundation on which MOFSL advice is based. Almost 10% of revenue is invested in equity research, and we hire and train the best resources to become our advisors. At present we have 25+ research analysts researching over 250 companies across 20 sectors. From a fundamental, technical, and derivatives research perspective, Motilal Oswal’s research reports have received wide coverage in the media.Our consistent efforts towards quality equity research have reflected in an increase in the ratings and rankings across various categories in the AsiaMoney Brokers Poll over the years. We have also been awarded the Best Performing Equity Broker (National) at the CNBC TV18 Financial Advisor Awards for five years in a row & got inducted into the ‘Hall of Fame’ at the 10th Financial Advisory Awards 2019.SEBI Registration Details - http://bit.ly/4ek37zO

basic_info.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd
basic_info.profile_name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd
basic_info.description: Maharatna ONGC is the largest producer of crude oil and natural gas in India, contributing around 70 per cent of Indian domestic production. The crude oil is the raw material used by downstream companies like IOC, BPCL, HPCL to produce petroleum products like Petrol, Diesel, Kerosene, Naphtha, Cooking Gas-LPG.ONGC is India’s Top Energy Company and ranks 14th among global energy majors (Platts). It is the only Indian company to figure in Fortune’s ‘Most Admired Energy Companies’ list. ONGC ranks 226th overall in Forbes Global 2000. Acclaimed for its Corporate Governance practices, Transparency International has ranked ONGC 26th among the biggest publicly traded global giants. It is most valued public enterprise in India, and one of the highest profit-making and dividend-paying.ONGC has a unique distinction of being a company with in-house service capabilities in all areas of Exploration and Production of oil & gas and related oil-field services. Winner of the Best Employer award, a dedicated team of over 25,000 professionals toil round the clock in challenging locations.ONGC is an integrated energy company with interests in upstream, midstream and downstream sector of the hydrocarbon value chain, renewables, LNG, Power generation, petrochemicals and Value Added Products. ONGC's wholly-owned subsidiary Navratna ONGC Videsh Limited (OVL) is the biggest Indian multinational in the energy space, participating in 32 oil and gas properties in 15 countries. ONGC's subsidiary Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (MRPL) is a Schedule ‘A’ Miniratna, with a single-location refining capacity of 15 million tons per annum. ONGC subsidiary HPCL is a Maharatna CPSE, and has the second largest share of product pipelines in India with a pipeline network of more than 3370 kms for transportation of petroleum products and a vast marketing network consisting of 14 Zonal offices and 133 Regional Offices.

basic_info.name: Shree Cement Ltd.
basic_info.description: Shree Cement is one of India’s top three cement producers and among the country’s most respected names in the building materials industry.From a single plant in Beawar, Rajasthan, our journey of over four decades has grown into a diversified manufacturing footprint across India and the UAE, with cement capacity exceeding 70 MTPA. This growth has been built on a strong culture of operational excellence, cost leadership, innovation and disciplined expansion.Sustainability has long been central to the Shree way of doing business. More than 62% of our electricity requirement is met through green sources, including Waste Heat Recovery, solar and wind energy, supported by a green power generation capacity of 634.5 MW. We are also more than 8X water positive and continue to invest in resource efficiency, circularity and cleaner manufacturing.Our portfolio includes some of India’s trusted cement brands, led by Bangur, along with a growing Ready Mix Concrete business with 36 plants pan India.Beyond business, Shree Cement works closely with communities around its operations through initiatives spanning healthcare, education, water conservation, livelihoods, infrastructure and environmental stewardship.As India builds for the future, we continue to expand responsibly, innovate continuously and create materials and solutions that contribute to stronger homes, infrastructure and communities.Building today. Creating possibilities for generations.

basic_info.name: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd
basic_info.description: Torrent Pharma, with annual revenues of more than Rs 11,500 crores, is the flagship Company of the Torrent Group, with group revenues of Rs 45,000 crores. It is ranked 5th in the Indian Pharma Market and is among the Top 5 in the therapeutic segments of Cardiovascular (CV), Central Nervous System (CNS), Gastro-intestinal (GI),  Vitamins Minerals Nutritionals (VMN) and Cosmo-Dermatology. The Company also has significant presence in diabetology, pain management, gynaecology, oncology and anti-infective segments. Torrent has 8 manufacturing facilities , of which 5 are USFDA approved. With R&D as the backbone for its growth in domestic & overseas market, it has invested significantly in R&D capabilities with state-of-the-art R&D infrastructure employing around 800 scientists.The acquisition of Elder Pharma's Indian branded business in 2013, Dermaceuticals business of Zyg Pharma in 2015, API plant of Glochem Industries in 2016, Women healthcare brands from Novartis and Unichem's Indian branded business along with its Sikkim Plant in 2017 strengthened Torrent Pharma's position in the Indian Pharma market.Torrent Pharma started international acquisitions in 2005 with entry into the German market. Today, the Company has presence in more than 50 countries and is ranked No. 1 among the Indian pharma Companies in Brazil and Germany. Torrent Pharma is committed towards “not just healthcare but lifecare.”

basic_info.name: SBI Life Insurance Co. Ltd.

basic_info.name: Mamaearth
basic_info.description: We are parents just like you. Our journey began when we, Ghazal and Varun, were expecting our first child. That’s the time we turned from a bungee jumping, pub hopping, carefree couple to basically a couple of safety wardens. Everything had to be safe, kosher & googled. When the morning sickness became a routine, we were shocked to find that there were no safer alternatives to pills and ended up having to struggle a lot.After 9 rigorous months, we were finally blessed with our tiny little bundle of joy and just like you and every other parent in the world; we too wanted the best for our cute bambino. So we wore our spyglasses & did all the possible research available. Whoa, we were shocked to see how most baby products, be it lotion or shampoo contained toxins which have proven to be harmful to the little ones. We were worried sick and it wasn’t just our baby we were worried about but also for all the little ones we knew in our friend circle. That’s when we decided to do something about it & create products which were completely safe & certified toxin free. A brand, by a parent, for the parent. A brand which develops products from world-class research and attempts to solve every little problem that we as parents face. With the aim of making products which are mum-baby friendly, toxin-free, meet stringent international standards & are basically ultra-awesome, Mamaearth was born.

basic_info.name: Mamaearth
basic_info.description: We are parents just like you. Our journey began when we, Ghazal and Varun, were expecting our first child. That’s the time we turned from a bungee jumping, pub hopping, carefree couple to basically a couple of safety wardens. Everything had to be safe, kosher & googled. When the morning sickness became a routine, we were shocked to find that there were no safer alternatives to pills and ended up having to struggle a lot.After 9 rigorous months, we were finally blessed with our tiny little bundle of joy and just like you and every other parent in the world; we too wanted the best for our cute bambino. So we wore our spyglasses & did all the possible research available. Whoa, we were shocked to see how most baby products, be it lotion or shampoo contained toxins which have proven to be harmful to the little ones. We were worried sick and it wasn’t just our baby we were worried about but also for all the little ones we knew in our friend circle. That’s when we decided to do something about it & create products which were completely safe & certified toxin free. A brand, by a parent, for the parent. A brand which develops products from world-class research and attempts to solve every little problem that we as parents face. With the aim of making products which are mum-baby friendly, toxin-free, meet stringent international standards & are basically ultra-awesome, Mamaearth was born.

content.description:
Role: Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – Agentic AI (TMS)Location: GurgaonWhat is TMS?A transportation management system (TMS) is a logistics platform that helps businesses plan, execute, and optimize the physical movement of goods, both inbound and outbound. It provides visibility into day-to-day transportation operations, ensures regulatory and trade compliance along with the associated documentation, and tracks the timely delivery of freight. A TMS streamlines shipping and makes transportation operations easier to manage and optimize.
Why Agentic TMS?Traditional TMS platforms digitize workflows but still depend on people to run them. Procurement teams run RFQs and chase spot quotes, planners build loads, coordinators chase carriers, analysts audit invoices, and support teams field customer queries. We are building AI agents that take on these jobs end to end:Agents that procure freight capacity through spot quotes, and transporter bidsAgents that plan and optimize loadsAgents that coordinate with transporter and shippersAgents that track and manage exceptionsAgents that audit and settle freight invoicesAgents that answer customer queriesThese agents run as autonomous systems, with humans in the loop only when needed. They are not copilots bolted onto screens.We are seeking an AI-first Product Builder to join our team in Gurgaon. This is a product management role for someone who builds, not just specs. You will take ideas from customer conversation to working agent yourself, using AI-assisted development to close the gap between “what if” and “it works.” To succeed, you should:Enjoy getting your hands dirtyThrive on end-to-end ownershipLet data, not opinion, drive product decisionsBe excited about defining how AI agents do real operational work in logistics
Expectations from a PM:Owns discovery and build of agentic features. This includes identifying which logistics workflows can be automated by agents, and to what degree of autonomy.Builds before writing. You prototype agents, tools, and workflows hands-on to validate an idea in days, then use the working prototype to align customers, design, and engineering.Designs agent behavior end to end:Goals, decision logic, and the tools/APIs the agent callsContext and data sourcesGuardrails, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop checkpointsDefines and owns evaluation frameworks for agents. This covers golden datasets, accuracy and decision-quality benchmarks, regression evals before every release, and monitoring for drift in production. Evals are written and run in code, not tracked in spreadsheets.Develops and ships production code via AI-assisted tools (Kiro), and submits all changes as PRs. Owns agent prompts, tool definitions, and configs in the repo like any other code.Conducts customer discovery, starts with high-level specs, and translates insights directly into product. Everything is documented before productionizing, including agent specs, prompts, tool contracts, and eval criteria.Balances agent quality against cost and latency, including model selection, token economics, and the right mix of deterministic logic and LLM reasoning.Owns product analytics, workflow QA, release notes, and pilot customers.Drives every decision with data, from what to build to whether it worked:Sets success metrics and baselines before building, not after shippingAnalyzes agent decisions and failure patterns to decide what to fix, automate further, or roll backBacks product calls with evidence in reviews, and changes course when the data says soOwns feature correctness, rollout quality, customer adoption, and feature-level metrics in production. Agent metrics include:Automation/touchless rateDecision accuracyEscalation rateTime and cost saved per transactionBuilds user trust in agents through explainability, audit trails, and clear handoffs between agent and operator.Escalates architectural questions to dev before building, and treats review feedback as blocking.
What we are looking for:Undergraduate degree in engineering from a Tier-I institute2+ years of product management experience in enterprise-grade SaaS products or a supply chain organizationA builder’s track record: products, agents, or tools you have built and shipped yourself using AI tools, ideally including LLM-powered or agentic features in production. Links to things you’ve built are welcome.Comfort working in code, including:Reading and writing Python or TypeScript with AI assistanceWorking with Git, APIs, and SQLDebugging your own work before handing it offStrong data orientation: comfortable with numbers and analysis tools, able to work with messy operational data, and has a track record of product decisions driven by quantitative evidenceWorking understanding of:LLM capabilities and limitations (hallucination, non-determinism, context limits)Prompt and context engineeringTool/function calling and agent orchestration patternsExperience designing evals or quality frameworks for AI systems, with comfort judging when an agent is “good enough” to shipExposure to logistics or transportation workflows (procurement, planning, execution, freight audit and payment) is a strong plusStrong communication and organization skills, and the ability to think clearly, problem-solve, multi-task, and prioritizeAbility to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, with the tenacity to develop ideas independently and the conviction to drive them to completion

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally.
